If the node is not\n// paused it is a no-op, so resume actions are harmless if the scheduled\n// pause boundary already elapsed.\nfunc (e *Engine) ResumeNode(id string) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif p == nil || !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}","originalFile":"// Package sim implements a deterministic, single-process discrete event\n// simulator for a fenced-lease lock: a lock service that hands out leases with\n// monotonically increasing fencing tokens, clients that renew by heartbeat,\n// and a protected resource that rejects writes carrying stale tokens.\n//\n// There are no real sockets, goroutines (for simulation logic) or clocks:\n// every node runs at logical times chosen by the Engine, and message delivery\n// goes through an injectable Network model that can drop, duplicate, delay\n// and reorder packets.\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// Time is logical simulation time, in milliseconds. Time only moves forward.\ntype Time int64\n\n// Kind selects the concrete payload of an Event.\ntype Kind int\n\nconst (\n\tKindMessage Kind = iota // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer               // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction              // a scripted client action runs\n)\n\n// Event is one item in the engine's event queue.\ntype Event struct {\n\tTime Time\n\tKind Kind\n\n\tDst   string // KindMessage / KindAction: target node\n\tMsg   *Envelope\n\tNode  string // KindTimer: owning node\n\tName  string // KindTimer: timer name\n\tAct   *ActionSpec\n\tTimer int64 // KindTimer: per-(node,name) version, for lazy cancellation\n\n\tseq int64 // insertion sequence; tie-breaks equal (Time, Kind) for determinism\n}\n\ntype eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].Time != h[j].Time {\n\t\treturn h[i].Time < h[j].Time\n\t}\n\tif h[i].Kind != h[j].Kind {\n\t\treturn h[i].Kind < h[j].Kind\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)  { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\te := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// Node is implemented by every simulated node (client, lock service, resource).\ntype Node interface {\n\tID() string\n\t// HandleMessage processes a delivered network message.\n\tHandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope)\n\t// OnTimer processes a named timer fired by the engine.\n\tOnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string)\n\t// OnAction processes a scripted scenario action.\n\tOnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec)\n\t// OnPause / OnResume notify the node that it was paused/resumed. Its\n\t// pending timers and inbound messages are frozen over the interval.\n\tOnPause(h Host, t Time)\n\tOnResume(h Host, t Time)\n}\n\n// Host is the engine-facing API a node may call while it is being dispatched.\ntype Host interface {\n\tNow() Time\n\tSend(msg *Envelope)\n\tSetTimer(node, name string, at Time)\n\tCancelTimer(node, name string)\n\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tRng() *Rng\n}\n\n// Recorder receives trace events, in simulation order.\ntype Recorder interface {\n\tRecord(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any)\n}\n\ntype pauseState struct {\n\tpaused bool\n\tuntil  Time\n\theld   []*Event // events whose scheduled time fell inside the pause\n}\n\n// Engine is the simulation kernel.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tnow   Time\n\tqueue eventHeap\n\tseq   int64\n\tevent int64 // processed-event counter, included in every trace record\n\n\tnodes   map[string]Node\n\tpauses  map[string]*pauseState\n\tnet     *Network\n\trec     Recorder\n\trng     *Rng\n\tmaxTime Time\n\n\t// timers holds the current version of each named timer; scheduled events\n\t// carrying an older version are stale and dropped (lazy cancellation).\n\ttimers map[[2]string]timerEntry\n}\n\ntype timerEntry struct {\n\tversion int64\n\tat      Time\n}\n\n// NewEngine builds an engine. seed fully determines probabilistic faults.\nfunc NewEngine(net *Network, rec Recorder, seed uint64, maxTime Time) *Engine {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tnodes:   map[string]Node{},\n\t\tpauses:  map[string]*pauseState{},\n\t\ttimers:  map[[2]string]timerEntry{},\n\t\tnet:     net,\n\t\trec:     rec,\n\t\trng:     NewRng(seed),\n\t\tmaxTime: maxTime,\n\t}\n\theap.Init(&e.queue)\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// AddNode registers a node; must be called before Run.\nfunc (e *Engine) AddNode(n Node) {\n\tif _, dup := e.nodes[n.ID()]; dup {\n\t\tpanic(\"duplicate node \" + n.ID())\n\t}\n\te.nodes[n.ID()] = n\n\te.pauses[n.ID()] = &pauseState{}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Now() Time { return e.now }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Rng() *Rng { return e.rng }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Log(event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\te.record(e.now, \"\", event, detail)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) record(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tif e.rec != nil {\n\t\te.rec.Record(t, node, event, detail)\n\t}\n}\n\n// SetTimer schedules a named timer for node at time at, replacing any current\n// timer with the same (node, name).\nfunc (e *Engine) SetTimer(node, name string, at Time) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tcur := e.timers[k]\n\tcur.version++\n\tcur.at = at\n\te.timers[k] = cur\n\tev := &Event{\n\t\tTime:  at,\n\t\tKind:  KindTimer,\n\t\tNode:  node,\n\t\tName:  name,\n\t\tTimer: cur.version,\n\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) CancelTimer(node, name string) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tif c, ok := e.timers[k]; ok {\n\t\tc.version++\n\t\te.timers[k] = c\n\t}\n}\n\n// nextSeq hands out a monotonic id for deterministic tie-breaking.\nfunc (e *Engine) nextSeq() int64 {\n\te.seq++\n\treturn e.seq\n}\n\n// PauseNode pauses node id: events due before until are held back, then\n// delivered at the resume time. Idempotent: a pause already covering until\n// is a no-op; re-pausing extends the interval.\nfunc (e *Engine) PauseNode(id string, until Time) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\tp.paused = true\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\t\tn.OnPause(e, e.now)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif until > p.until {\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// dispatch holds or delivers an event depending on the destination pause.\n// pause/resume actions bypass the hold: they control the pause itself and\n// must run even while the node is frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(ev *Event, held bool) {\n\tvar dst string\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\t\tif ev.Act != nil && (ev.Act.Op == OpPause || ev.Act.Op == OpResume) {\n\t\t\theld = false\n\t\t}\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\tdst = ev.Node\n\t}\n\tp := e.pauses[dst]\n\tif p != nil && p.paused && held {\n\t\tp.held = append(p.held, ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.deliver(ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(ev *Event) {\n\tn, ok := e.nodes[ev.Dst]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tn, ok = e.nodes[ev.Node]\n\t}\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.event++\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tn.HandleMessage(e, ev.Time, ev.Msg)\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\t// Drop stale (cancelled/replaced) timer versions.\n\t\tif c, ok := e.timers[[2]string{ev.Node, ev.Name}]; !ok || c.version != ev.Timer {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.OnTimer(e, ev.Time, ev.Name)\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tn.OnAction(e, ev.Time, ev.Act)\n\t}\n}\n\n// scheduleAction enqueues a scripted action from the scenario.\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleAction(a *ActionSpec) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: a.At, Kind: KindAction, Dst: a.Client, Act: a, seq: e.nextSeq()}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// Send hands an outbound message to the network model and schedules its\n// delivery (or deliveries, for duplicates). Messages sent while the sender\n// is paused are dropped: a frozen node cannot produce traffic.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(msg *Envelope) {\n\tmsg.ID = e.nextSeq()\n\tmsg.SendTime = e.now\n\tsenderPaused := e.pauses[msg.Src] != nil && e.pauses[msg.Src].paused\n\toffers := e.net.Transmit(e, msg, senderPaused)\n\tfor _, o := range offers {\n\t\tev := &Event{\n\t\t\tTime:  o.deliverAt,\n\t\t\tKind:  KindMessage,\n\t\t\tDst:   msg.Dst,\n\t\t\tMsg:   o.msg,\n\t\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t\t}\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run drains the event queue until maxTime, then returns the number of events\n// processed (including held-but-never-delivered events at horizon? no: only\n// dispatched events are counted).\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(actions []*ActionSpec) (processed int64, err error) {\n\tfor _, a := range actions {\n\t\tif e.nodes[a.Client] == nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"action at t=%d: unknown client %q\", a.At, a.Client)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.scheduleAction(a)\n\t}\n\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > e.maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Only one node can\n\t\t// resume per event (each pause created its own boundary event), but a\n\t\t// resumed node may immediately process another due pause; loop until\n\t\t// stable so ordering stays deterministic.\n\t\tfor id, p := range e.pauses {\n\t\t\tif p.paused && p.until <= e.now {\n\t\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\te.dispatch(ev, true)\n\t\tprocessed = e.event\n\t}\n\n\t// Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.\n\tfor id, p := range e.pauses {\n\t\tif p.paused {\n\t\t\te.now = p.until\n\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn processed, nil\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":215,"oldLines":9,"newStart":215,"newLines":23,"lines":["   }"," }"," ","+// ResumeNode ends a pause immediately (at h.Now()). Time only moves forward.\ntype Time int64\n\n// Kind selects the concrete payload of an Event.\ntype Kind int\n\nconst (\n\tKindMessage Kind = iota // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer               // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction              // a scripted client action runs\n)\n\n// Event is one item in the engine's event queue.\ntype Event struct {\n\tTime Time\n\tKind Kind\n\n\tDst   string // KindMessage / KindAction: target node\n\tMsg   *Envelope\n\tNode  string // KindTimer: owning node\n\tName  string // KindTimer: timer name\n\tAct   *ActionSpec\n\tTimer int64 // KindTimer: per-(node,name) version, for lazy cancellation\n\n\tseq int64 // insertion sequence; tie-breaks equal (Time, Kind) for determinism\n}\n\ntype eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].Time != h[j].Time {\n\t\treturn h[i].Time < h[j].Time\n\t}\n\tif h[i].Kind != h[j].Kind {\n\t\treturn h[i].Kind < h[j].Kind\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)  { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\te := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// Node is implemented by every simulated node (client, lock service, resource).\ntype Node interface {\n\tID() string\n\t// HandleMessage processes a delivered network message.\n\tHandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope)\n\t// OnTimer processes a named timer fired by the engine.\n\tOnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string)\n\t// OnAction processes a scripted scenario action.\n\tOnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec)\n\t// OnPause / OnResume notify the node that it was paused/resumed. Its\n\t// pending timers and inbound messages are frozen over the interval.\n\tOnPause(h Host, t Time)\n\tOnResume(h Host, t Time)\n}\n\n// Host is the engine-facing API a node may call while it is being dispatched.\ntype Host interface {\n\tNow() Time\n\tSend(msg *Envelope)\n\tSetTimer(node, name string, at Time)\n\tCancelTimer(node, name string)\n\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tRng() *Rng\n}\n\n// Recorder receives trace events, in simulation order.\ntype Recorder interface {\n\tRecord(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any)\n}\n\ntype pauseState struct {\n\tpaused bool\n\tuntil  Time\n\theld   []*Event // events whose scheduled time fell inside the pause\n}\n\n// Engine is the simulation kernel.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tnow   Time\n\tqueue eventHeap\n\tseq   int64\n\tevent int64 // processed-event counter, included in every trace record\n\n\tnodes   map[string]Node\n\tpauses  map[string]*pauseState\n\tnet     *Network\n\trec     Recorder\n\trng     *Rng\n\tmaxTime Time\n\n\t// timers holds the current version of each named timer; scheduled events\n\t// carrying an older version are stale and dropped (lazy cancellation).\n\ttimers map[[2]string]timerEntry\n}\n\ntype timerEntry struct {\n\tversion int64\n\tat      Time\n}\n\n// NewEngine builds an engine. seed fully determines probabilistic faults.\nfunc NewEngine(net *Network, rec Recorder, seed uint64, maxTime Time) *Engine {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tnodes:   map[string]Node{},\n\t\tpauses:  map[string]*pauseState{},\n\t\ttimers:  map[[2]string]timerEntry{},\n\t\tnet:     net,\n\t\trec:     rec,\n\t\trng:     NewRng(seed),\n\t\tmaxTime: maxTime,\n\t}\n\theap.Init(&e.queue)\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// AddNode registers a node; must be called before Run.\nfunc (e *Engine) AddNode(n Node) {\n\tif _, dup := e.nodes[n.ID()]; dup {\n\t\tpanic(\"duplicate node \" + n.ID())\n\t}\n\te.nodes[n.ID()] = n\n\te.pauses[n.ID()] = &pauseState{}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Now() Time { return e.now }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Rng() *Rng { return e.rng }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Log(event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\te.record(e.now, \"\", event, detail)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) record(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tif e.rec != nil {\n\t\te.rec.Record(t, node, event, detail)\n\t}\n}\n\n// SetTimer schedules a named timer for node at time at, replacing any current\n// timer with the same (node, name).\nfunc (e *Engine) SetTimer(node, name string, at Time) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tcur := e.timers[k]\n\tcur.version++\n\tcur.at = at\n\te.timers[k] = cur\n\tev := &Event{\n\t\tTime:  at,\n\t\tKind:  KindTimer,\n\t\tNode:  node,\n\t\tName:  name,\n\t\tTimer: cur.version,\n\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) CancelTimer(node, name string) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tif c, ok := e.timers[k]; ok {\n\t\tc.version++\n\t\te.timers[k] = c\n\t}\n}\n\n// nextSeq hands out a monotonic id for deterministic tie-breaking.\nfunc (e *Engine) nextSeq() int64 {\n\te.seq++\n\treturn e.seq\n}\n\n// PauseNode pauses node id: events due before until are held back, then\n// delivered at the resume time. Idempotent: a pause already covering until\n// is a no-op; re-pausing extends the interval.\nfunc (e *Engine) PauseNode(id string, until Time) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\tp.paused = true\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\t\tn.OnPause(e, e.now)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif until > p.until {\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// ResumeNode ends a pause immediately (at h.Now()). If the node is not\n// paused it is a no-op, so resume actions are harmless if the scheduled\n// pause boundary already elapsed.\nfunc (e *Engine) ResumeNode(id string) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif p == nil || !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// dispatch holds or delivers an event depending on the destination pause.\n// pause/resume actions bypass the hold: they control the pause itself and\n// must run even while the node is frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(ev *Event, held bool) {\n\tvar dst string\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\t\tif ev.Act != nil && (ev.Act.Op == OpPause || ev.Act.Op == OpResume) {\n\t\t\theld = false\n\t\t}\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\tdst = ev.Node\n\t}\n\tp := e.pauses[dst]\n\tif p != nil && p.paused && held {\n\t\tp.held = append(p.held, ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.deliver(ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(ev *Event) {\n\tn, ok := e.nodes[ev.Dst]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tn, ok = e.nodes[ev.Node]\n\t}\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.event++\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tn.HandleMessage(e, ev.Time, ev.Msg)\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\t// Drop stale (cancelled/replaced) timer versions.\n\t\tif c, ok := e.timers[[2]string{ev.Node, ev.Name}]; !ok || c.version != ev.Timer {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.OnTimer(e, ev.Time, ev.Name)\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tn.OnAction(e, ev.Time, ev.Act)\n\t}\n}\n\n// scheduleAction enqueues a scripted action from the scenario.\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleAction(a *ActionSpec) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: a.At, Kind: KindAction, Dst: a.Client, Act: a, seq: e.nextSeq()}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// Send hands an outbound message to the network model and schedules its\n// delivery (or deliveries, for duplicates). Messages sent while the sender\n// is paused are dropped: a frozen node cannot produce traffic.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(msg *Envelope) {\n\tmsg.ID = e.nextSeq()\n\tmsg.SendTime = e.now\n\tsenderPaused := e.pauses[msg.Src] != nil && e.pauses[msg.Src].paused\n\toffers := e.net.Transmit(e, msg, senderPaused)\n\tfor _, o := range offers {\n\t\tev := &Event{\n\t\t\tTime:  o.deliverAt,\n\t\t\tKind:  KindMessage,\n\t\t\tDst:   msg.Dst,\n\t\t\tMsg:   o.msg,\n\t\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t\t}\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run drains the event queue until maxTime, then returns the number of events\n// processed (including held-but-never-delivered events at horizon? no: only\n// dispatched events are counted).\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(actions []*ActionSpec) (processed int64, err error) {\n\tfor _, a := range actions {\n\t\tif e.nodes[a.Client] == nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"action at t=%d: unknown client %q\", a.At, a.Client)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.scheduleAction(a)\n\t}\n\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > e.maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Only one node can\n\t\t// resume per event (each pause created its own boundary event), but a\n\t\t// resumed node may immediately process another due pause; loop until\n\t\t// stable so ordering stays deterministic.\n\t\tfor id, p := range e.pauses {\n\t\t\tif p.paused && p.until <= e.now {\n\t\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\te.dispatch(ev, true)\n\t\tprocessed = e.event\n\t}\n\n\t// Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.\n\tfor id, p := range e.pauses {\n\t\tif p.paused {\n\t\t\te.now = p.until\n\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn processed, nil\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":338,"oldLines":11,"newStart":338,"newLines":11,"lines":["     }","     e.now = ev.Time"," ","-    // Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Idempotent: a pause already covering until\n// is a no-op; re-pausing extends the interval.\nfunc (e *Engine) PauseNode(id string, until Time) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\tp.paused = true\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\t\tn.OnPause(e, e.now)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif until > p.until {\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// ResumeNode ends a pause immediately (at h.Now()). If the node is not\n// paused it is a no-op, so resume actions are harmless if the scheduled\n// pause boundary already elapsed.\nfunc (e *Engine) ResumeNode(id string) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif p == nil || !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// dispatch holds or delivers an event depending on the destination pause.\n// pause/resume actions bypass the hold: they control the pause itself and\n// must run even while the node is frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(ev *Event, held bool) {\n\tvar dst string\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\t\tif ev.Act != nil && (ev.Act.Op == OpPause || ev.Act.Op == OpResume) {\n\t\t\theld = false\n\t\t}\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\tdst = ev.Node\n\t}\n\tp := e.pauses[dst]\n\tif p != nil && p.paused && held {\n\t\tp.held = append(p.held, ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.deliver(ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(ev *Event) {\n\tn, ok := e.nodes[ev.Dst]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tn, ok = e.nodes[ev.Node]\n\t}\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.event++\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tn.HandleMessage(e, ev.Time, ev.Msg)\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\t// Drop stale (cancelled/replaced) timer versions.\n\t\tif c, ok := e.timers[[2]string{ev.Node, ev.Name}]; !ok || c.version != ev.Timer {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.OnTimer(e, ev.Time, ev.Name)\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tn.OnAction(e, ev.Time, ev.Act)\n\t}\n}\n\n// scheduleAction enqueues a scripted action from the scenario.\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleAction(a *ActionSpec) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: a.At, Kind: KindAction, Dst: a.Client, Act: a, seq: e.nextSeq()}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// Send hands an outbound message to the network model and schedules its\n// delivery (or deliveries, for duplicates). Messages sent while the sender\n// is paused are dropped: a frozen node cannot produce traffic.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(msg *Envelope) {\n\tmsg.ID = e.nextSeq()\n\tmsg.SendTime = e.now\n\tsenderPaused := e.pauses[msg.Src] != nil && e.pauses[msg.Src].paused\n\toffers := e.net.Transmit(e, msg, senderPaused)\n\tfor _, o := range offers {\n\t\tev := &Event{\n\t\t\tTime:  o.deliverAt,\n\t\t\tKind:  KindMessage,\n\t\t\tDst:   msg.Dst,\n\t\t\tMsg:   o.msg,\n\t\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t\t}\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run drains the event queue until maxTime, then returns the number of events\n// processed (including held-but-never-delivered events at horizon? no: only\n// dispatched events are counted).\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(actions []*ActionSpec) (processed int64, err error) {\n\tfor _, a := range actions {\n\t\tif e.nodes[a.Client] == nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"action at t=%d: unknown client %q\", a.At, a.Client)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.scheduleAction(a)\n\t}\n\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > e.maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Resuming may\n\t\t// enqueue held events at this same time; iterate node ids in sorted\n\t\t// order so multi-node resumes are deterministic (map order is not).\n\t\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\t\tif p.paused && p.until <= e.now {\n\t\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\te.dispatch(ev, true)\n\t\tprocessed = e.event\n\t}\n\n\t// Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.\n\tfor id, p := range e.pauses {\n\t\tif p.paused {\n\t\t\te.now = p.until\n\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn processed, nil\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":354,"oldLines":7,"newStart":354,"newLines":8,"lines":["   }"," ","   // Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.","-  for id, p := range e.pauses {","+  for _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {","+    p := e.pauses[id]","     if p.paused {","       e.now = p.until","       e.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)"]},{"oldStart":362,"oldLines":3,"newStart":363,"newLines":13,"lines":["   }","   return processed, nil"," }","+","+// pausedNodeIDs returns registered node ids in sorted order.","+func (e *Engine) pausedNodeIDs() []string {","+  ids := make([]string, 0, len(e.nodes))","+  for id := range e.nodes {","+    ids = append(ids, id)","+  }","+  sort.Strings(ids)","+  return ids","+}"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e7985199-b193-4f5d-b504-67d9f5706d92","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

{"parentUuid":"ce005574-8694-43df-9fd5-3a73bd5df61e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_66ls44lbtjcds7c0tpfqo4n6","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/network.go","content":"package sim\n\n// Fault types usable in scenario JSON (rules) and in Network config.\nconst (\n\tFaultDrop      = \"drop\"      // the packet is never delivered\n\tFaultDuplicate = \"duplicate\" // original plus one delayed copy\n\tFaultDelay     = \"delay\"     // held back for an extra delay\n\tFaultReorder   = \"reorder\"   // the same as delay, by convention\n)\n\n// Rule is a scripted, time-bounded network fault. Rules are checked in order\n// and the first match wins, so exact rules can shadow probabilistic behavior.\ntype Rule struct {\n\tType    string  `json:\"type\"`\n\tSrc     string  `json:\"src,omitempty\"`\n\tDst     string  `json:\"dst,omitempty\"`\n\tReqType string  `json:\"req_type,omitempty\"`\n\tMsgType string  `json:\"msg_type,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom    Time    `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tUntil   Time    `json:\"until,omitempty\"`\n\tDelay   Time    `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`\n\tProb    float64 `json:\"prob,omitempty\"` // optional: only apply with probability\n\n\tapplied int\n}\n\n// Match reports whether the rule selects msg at time t.\nfunc (r *Rule) Match(t Time, msg *Envelope) bool {\n\tif r.Src != \"\" && r.Src != \"*\" && r.Src != msg.Src {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.Dst != \"\" && r.Dst != \"*\" && r.Dst != msg.Dst {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.ReqType != \"\" && r.ReqType != msg.ReqType {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.MsgType != \"\" && r.MsgType != msg.Type {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.From != 0 && t < r.From {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.Until != 0 && t > r.Until {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Stats counts what the network did. Counters are part of the run report.\ntype Stats struct {\n\tSent       int64 `json:\"sent\"`\n\tDelivered  int64 `json:\"delivered\"` // scheduled deliveries, including copies\n\tDropped    int64 `json:\"dropped\"`\n\tDuplicated int64 `json:\"duplicated\"`\n\tDelayed    int64 `json:\"delayed\"`\n\tPausedDrop int64 `json:\"paused_sender_dropped\"`\n}\n\n// Network is the transmission model. One link for all node pairs; per-pair\n// behavior is expressed through rules and node filters.\ntype Network struct {\n\t// Baseline link behavior.\n\tMinLatency Time `json:\"min_latency_ms\"`\n\tMaxLatency Time `json:\"max_latency_ms\"`\n\n\t// Probabilistic faults applied when no scripted rule matches.\n\tDropProb      float64 `json:\"drop_prob\"`\n\tDuplicateProb float64 `json:\"duplicate_prob\"`\n\tDuplicateGap  Time    `json:\"duplicate_gap_ms\"`\n\n\tRules []*Rule `json:\"rules\"`\n\n\tStats Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\ntype offer struct {\n\tmsg       *Envelope\n\tdeliverAt Time\n}\n\n// Transmit applies the fault model to one outbound message and returns the\n// delivery offers for the engine to schedule.\nfunc (n *Network) Transmit(h Host, msg *Envelope, senderPaused bool) []offer {\n\trng := h.Rng()\n\tn.Stats.Sent++\n\n\tif senderPaused {\n\t\tn.Stats.Dropped++\n\t\tn.Stats.PausedDrop++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.drop\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"type\": msg.Type, \"src\": msg.Src, \"dst\": msg.Dst,\n\t\t\t\"reason\": \"sender_paused\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tbase := n.baseLatency(rng)\n\tnow := h.Now()\n\tdrop := rng.Bernoulli(n.DropProb)\n\tdup := rng.Bernoulli(n.DuplicateProb)\n\tvar rule *Rule\n\tfor _, r := range n.Rules {\n\t\tif r.Match(now, msg) && (r.Prob == 0 || rng.Bernoulli(r.Prob)) {\n\t\t\trule = r\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif rule != nil {\n\t\tr := rule\n\t\tr.applied++\n\t\tswitch r.Type {\n\t\tcase FaultDrop:\n\t\t\tdrop = true\n\t\tcase FaultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tdup = true\n\t\tcase FaultDelay, FaultReorder:\n\t\t\tbase += r.Delay\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif drop {\n\t\tn.Stats.Dropped++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.drop\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"type\": msg.Type, \"src\": msg.Src, \"dst\": msg.Dst,\n\t\t\t\"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tout := []offer{{msg: msg, deliverAt: now + base}}\n\tn.Stats.Delivered++\n\n\tif dup {\n\t\tgap := n.DuplicateGap\n\t\tif rule != nil && rule.Delay > 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = rule.Delay\n\t\t}\n\t\tif gap <= 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = 50\n\t\t}\n\t\tcopyMsg := *msg\n\t\tcopyMsg.DuplicateOf = msg.ID\n\t\tout = append(out, offer{msg: &copyMsg, deliverAt: now + base + gap})\n\t\tn.Stats.Duplicated++\n\t\tn.Stats.Delivered++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.duplicate\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"copy_gap\": gap,\n\t\t\t\"deliver_at\": now + base + gap, \"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif rule != nil && (rule.Type == FaultDelay || rule.Type == FaultReorder) {\n\t\tn.Stats.Delayed++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.delay\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"extra_ms\": rule.Delay,\n\t\t\t\"deliver_at\": now + base, \"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc matchedRuleName(r *Rule) string {\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\treturn \"probabilistic\"\n\t}\n\treturn r.Type\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) baseLatency(rng *Rng) Time {\n\tmin, max := n.MinLatency, n.MaxLatency\n\tif max <= min {\n\t\tif max < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn 0\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn max\n\t}\n\treturn min + Time(rng.Intn(int(max-min+1)))\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_98dfedc8e9db40e7ab322543","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1670,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":44856,"output_tokens":1634,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_66ls44lbtjcds7c0tpfqo4n6":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"54e31c42-a1e6-42bb-b3c1-a966bfd123ba","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"signature":"","thinking":"Now the lock service. \n\nAll design details for the lock service have been finalized, covering core identifiers, field configurations, request deduplication rules, timer logic and lazy expiry mechanism.\n\nThe core logic of the lock service for acquire, renew, release and resource management modules has been fully finalized, covering duplicate handling rules for all operation scenarios.\n\nI've finalized the fence handling rule for resource management: strictly increasing committed fence sequence is required, equal-fence requests from the same reqID are idempotent duplicates, and those from different reqIDs are stale.\n\nI've finalized the client-side field specifications, deduplication rules and heartbeat renewal timing logic, which will be implemented next.\n\nI've finalized the timer operation rules: the single timer will be rescheduled via SetTimer, and the latest configuration will take effect. On timer fire, a renew request will be sent first, then the timer will be set to the next heartbeat interval. After receiving the renew acknowledgment, the timer will be reset to the scheduled renewal time.\n\nI've confirmed that lease renewals consistently have around 680ms margin before expiry. The renewal error handling rule has been finalized, along with submission and pause operation specifications for client requests.\n\nI've finalized the rules for resume, acquire, renew and release operations for clients, as well as the rules for action counters, recorder and report runner modules. All 6 core consistency invariants required for the system have also been confirmed, covering fence sequence rules, lease validity checks and zombie attempt rejection logic.\n\nI've finished the invariant cross-check, added stale rejection counting, defined required snapshots, and will write the core code next.\n","type":"thinking"}],"id":"msg_e65a9189dcb641f2885d4e5c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":988,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":47928,"output_tokens":4391,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"type":"assistant","uuid":"7b868827-ca0a-4e8f-9e3a-d0691626f158","timestamp":"2026-09-23T03:51:59.426Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}
{"parentUuid":"7b868827-ca0a-4e8f-9e3a-d0691626f158","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"现在实现锁服务（租约 + 递增围栏号 + 惰性过期 + 请求去重缓存）。\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_e65a9189dcb641f2885d4e5c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":988,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":47928,"output_tokens":4391,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"9c871004-309f-4b72-a256-c93af7b8d47e","timestamp":"2026-09-23T03:51:59.771Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}
{"parentUuid":"9c871004-309f-4b72-a256-c93af7b8d47e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_20p7bofzwsqwwc1e9y1g98ft","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/lock.go","content":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"strconv\"\n)\n\n// Fixed node ids. The scenario models one lock and one protected resource;\n// every packet addresses them by these ids.\nconst (\n\tLockID     = \"L\"\n\tResourceID = \"R\"\n)\n\n// Timer names.\nconst (\n\tTimerLockExpire = \"lock.expire\"\n\tTimerHeartbeat  = \"heartbeat\"\n\tTimerAcqRetry   = \"acquire.retry\"\n)\n\n// Lease is the lock service's live-lease record.\ntype Lease struct {\n\tID        string `json:\"id\"`\n\tHolder    string `json:\"holder\"`\n\tFence     int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tGrantedAt Time   `json:\"granted_at\"`\n\tExpireAt  Time   `json:\"expire_at\"`\n}\n\n// LockSnapshot is the post-run state of the lock service.\ntype LockSnapshot struct {\n\tNodeID      string  `json:\"node\"`\n\tNextFence   int64   `json:\"next_fence\"`\n\tGrants      int64   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tExpirations int64   `json:\"expirations\"`\n\tCurrent     *Lease  `json:\"current_lease\"`\n\tHistory     []Lease `json:\"history\"`\n}\n\n// renewResult caches the answer to a renew request so a network-duplicated\n// renew cannot extend the lease twice.\ntype renewResult struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\texpireAt Time\n}\n\n// LockService is a single-lock lease manager with monotonic fencing tokens.\ntype LockService struct {\n\tttl Time\n\n\tcurrent   *Lease\n\tnextFence int64\n\tgrants    int64\n\texpires   int64\n\thistory   []Lease\n\n\t// renewCache: ReqID -> granted answer. Also dedupes acquire/release.\n\trenewCache map[string]renewResult\n\tackCache   map[string]*Envelope\n}\n\nfunc NewLockService(ttl Time) *LockService {\n\treturn &LockService{\n\t\tttl:        ttl,\n\t\tnextFence:  1,\n\t\trenewCache: map[string]renewResult{},\n\t\tackCache:   map[string]*Envelope{},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) ID() string { return LockID }\n\nfunc (l *LockService) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tl.expireIfDue(h, t)\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireReq:\n\t\tl.handleAcquire(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeRenewReq:\n\t\tl.handleRenew(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeReleaseReq:\n\t\tl.handleRelease(h, t, msg)\n\tdefault:\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.unexpected\", map[string]any{\"type\": msg.Type})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tif name != TimerLockExpire {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tl.expireIfDue(h, t)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnAction(Host, Time, *ActionSpec) {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnPause(Host, Time)               {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnResume(Host, Time)              {}\n\n// expireIfDue lazily expires the current lease, and also handles the\n// scheduled expiry timer. Expiry is what lets the lock move to a new holder\n// while the old one may still believe it holds the lock.\nfunc (l *LockService) expireIfDue(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif l.current == nil || t < l.current.ExpireAt {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdead := l.current\n\tl.current = nil\n\tl.expires++\n\th.CancelTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire)\n\th.Log(\"lock.expire\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"holder\": dead.Holder, \"lease_id\": dead.ID, \"fence\": dead.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": dead.ExpireAt, \"at\": t,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) reply(h Host, t Time, req *Envelope, ack *Envelope) {\n\tack.Src = LockID\n\tack.Dst = req.Src\n\tack.ReqType = req.ReqType\n\tack.ReqID = req.ReqID\n\tack.SendTime = t\n\th.Send(ack)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleAcquire(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tif cached, ok := l.ackCache[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\t// Retransmitted acquire of an already-granted lease: answer again\n\t\t// without consuming a new fence.\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.acquire.replay\", map[string]any{\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, cached)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif l.current != nil {\n\t\tack := &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType:   TypeAcquireBusy,\n\t\t\tResult: ResultBusy,\n\t\t\tReason: \"held\",\n\t\t}\n\t\tack.LeaseID = l.current.ID\n\t\tack.Fence = l.current.Fence\n\t\tack.ExpireAt = l.current.ExpireAt\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"holder\": l.current.Holder, \"fence\": l.current.Fence,\n\t\t})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tlease := &Lease{\n\t\tID:        \"lease-\" + strconv.FormatInt(l.nextFence, 10),\n\t\tHolder:    msg.Src,\n\t\tFence:     l.nextFence,\n\t\tGrantedAt: t,\n\t\tExpireAt:  t + l.ttl,\n\t}\n\tl.nextFence++\n\tl.grants++\n\tl.current = lease\n\tl.history = append(l.history, *lease)\n\n\tack := &Envelope{\n\t\tType: TypeAcquireAck, Result: ResultGranted,\n\t\tLeaseID: lease.ID, Fence: lease.Fence, ExpireAt: lease.ExpireAt,\n\t}\n\tl.ackCache[msg.ReqID] = ack\n\th.SetTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire, lease.ExpireAt)\n\th.Log(\"lock.grant\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": lease.ID, \"fence\": lease.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": lease.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleRenew(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\t// Duplicated renew packet: repeat the recorded answer, never re-extend.\n\tif cached, ok := l.renewCache[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.renew.dedup\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID, \"fence\": cached.fence,\n\t\t})\n\t\tack := &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType: TypeRenewAck, Result: ResultCommitted,\n\t\t\tLeaseID: msg.LeaseID, Fence: cached.fence, ExpireAt: cached.expireAt,\n\t\t}\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif l.current == nil || l.current.Holder != msg.Src || l.current.ID != msg.LeaseID {\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.renew.expired\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID,\n\t\t})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType: TypeRenewErr, Result: ResultExpired, Reason: \"lease expired or unknown\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tnewExpire := t + l.ttl\n\tl.current.ExpireAt = newExpire\n\tl.renewCache[msg.ReqID] = renewResult{fence: l.current.Fence, expireAt: newExpire}\n\t// Move the lease's expiry boundary with the new deadline.\n\th.SetTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire, newExpire)\n\th.Log(\"lock.renew\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": l.current.ID, \"fence\": l.current.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": newExpire,\n\t})\n\tl.reply(h, t, msg, &Envelope{\n\t\tType: TypeRenewAck, Result: ResultCommitted,\n\t\tLeaseID: l.current.ID, Fence: l.current.Fence, ExpireAt: newExpire,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleRelease(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tif cached, ok := l.ackCache[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.release.replay\", map[string]any{\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, cached)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif l.current == nil || l.current.Holder != msg.Src || l.current.ID != msg.LeaseID {\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType: TypeReleaseErr, Result: ResultExpired, Reason: \"not the live lease\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treleased := l.current\n\tl.current = nil\n\th.CancelTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire)\n\tack := &Envelope{Type: TypeReleaseAck, Result: ResultCommitted, Fence: released.Fence}\n\tl.ackCache[msg.ReqID] = ack\n\th.Log(\"lock.release\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": released.ID, \"fence\": released.Fence,\n\t})\n\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns the terminal state for the run report.\nfunc (l *LockService) Snapshot() LockSnapshot {\n\tsnap := LockSnapshot{\n\t\tNodeID:      LockID,\n\t\tNextFence:   l.nextFence,\n\t\tGrants:      l.grants,\n\t\tExpirations: int64(l.expires),\n\t\tHistory:     append([]Lease(nil), l.history...),\n\t}\n\tif l.current != nil {\n\t\tc := *l.current\n\t\tsnap.Current = &c\n\t}\n\treturn snap\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e65a9189dcb641f2885d4e5c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":988,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":47928,"output_tokens":4391,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_20p7bofzwsqwwc1e9y1g98ft":{"content":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"strconv\"\n)\n\n// Fixed node ids. Also dedupes acquire/release.\n\trenewCache map[string]renewResult\n\tackCache   map[string]*Envelope\n}\n\nfunc NewLockService(ttl Time) *LockService {\n\treturn &LockService{\n\t\tttl:        ttl,\n\t\tnextFence:  1,\n\t\trenewCache: map[string]renewResult{},\n\t\tackCache:   map[string]*Envelope{},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) ID() string { return LockID }\n\nfunc (l *LockService) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tl.expireIfDue(h, t)\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireReq:\n\t\tl.handleAcquire(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeRenewReq:\n\t\tl.handleRenew(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeReleaseReq:\n\t\tl.handleRelease(h, t, msg)\n\tdefault:\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.unexpected\", map[string]any{\"type\": msg.Type})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tif name != TimerLockExpire {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tl.expireIfDue(h, t)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnAction(Host, Time, *ActionSpec) {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnPause(Host, Time)               {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnResume(Host, Time)              {}\n\n// expireIfDue lazily expires the current lease, and also handles the\n// scheduled expiry timer. Expiry is what lets the lock move to a new holder\n// while the old one may still believe it holds the lock.\nfunc (l *LockService) expireIfDue(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif l.current == nil || t < l.current.ExpireAt {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdead := l.current\n\tl.current = nil\n\tl.expires++\n\th.CancelTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire)\n\th.Log(\"lock.expire\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"holder\": dead.Holder, \"lease_id\": dead.ID, \"fence\": dead.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": dead.ExpireAt, \"at\": t,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) reply(h Host, t Time, req *Envelope, ack *Envelope) {\n\tack.Src = LockID\n\tack.Dst = req.Src\n\tack.ReqType = req.ReqType\n\tack.ReqID = req.ReqID\n\tack.SendTime = t\n\th.Send(ack)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleAcquire(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tif cached, ok := l.ackCache[msg.ReqID]; The scenario models one lock and one protected resource;\n// every packet addresses them by these ids.\nconst (\n\tLockID     = \"L\"\n\tResourceID = \"R\"\n)\n\n// Timer names.\nconst (\n\tTimerLockExpire = \"lock.expire\"\n\tTimerHeartbeat  = \"heartbeat\"\n\tTimerAcqRetry   = \"acquire.retry\"\n)\n\n// Lease is the lock service's live-lease record.\ntype Lease struct {\n\tID        string `json:\"id\"`\n\tHolder    string `json:\"holder\"`\n\tFence     int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tGrantedAt Time   `json:\"granted_at\"`\n\tExpireAt  Time   `json:\"expire_at\"`\n}\n\n// LockSnapshot is the post-run state of the lock service.\ntype LockSnapshot struct {\n\tNodeID      string  `json:\"node\"`\n\tNextFence   int64   `json:\"next_fence\"`\n\tGrants      int64   `json:\"grants\"`\n\tExpirations int64   `json:\"expirations\"`\n\tCurrent     *Lease  `json:\"current_lease\"`\n\tHistory     []Lease `json:\"history\"`\n}\n\n// renewResult caches the answer to a renew request so a network-duplicated\n// renew cannot extend the lease twice.\ntype renewResult struct {\n\tfence    int64\n\texpireAt Time\n}\n\n// LockService is a single-lock lease manager with monotonic fencing tokens.\ntype LockService struct {\n\tttl Time\n\n\tcurrent   *Lease\n\tnextFence int64\n\tgrants    int64\n\texpires   int64\n\thistory   []Lease\n\n\t// renewCache: ReqID -> granted answer. Also dedupes acquire/release.\n\trenewCache map[string]renewResult\n\tackCache   map[string]*Envelope\n}\n\nfunc NewLockService(ttl Time) *LockService {\n\treturn &LockService{\n\t\tttl:        ttl,\n\t\tnextFence:  1,\n\t\trenewCache: map[string]renewResult{},\n\t\tackCache:   map[string]*Envelope{},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) ID() string { return LockID }\n\nfunc (l *LockService) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tl.expireIfDue(h, t)\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireReq:\n\t\tl.handleAcquire(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeRenewReq:\n\t\tl.handleRenew(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeReleaseReq:\n\t\tl.handleRelease(h, t, msg)\n\tdefault:\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.unexpected\", map[string]any{\"type\": msg.Type})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tif name != TimerLockExpire {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tl.expireIfDue(h, t)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnAction(Host, Time, *ActionSpec) {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnPause(Host, Time)               {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnResume(Host, Time)              {}\n\n// expireIfDue lazily expires the current lease, and also handles the\n// scheduled expiry timer. Expiry is what lets the lock move to a new holder\n// while the old one may still believe it holds the lock.\nfunc (l *LockService) expireIfDue(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif l.current == nil || t < l.current.ExpireAt {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdead := l.current\n\tl.current = nil\n\tl.expires++\n\th.CancelTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire)\n\th.Log(\"lock.expire\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"holder\": dead.Holder, \"lease_id\": dead.ID, \"fence\": dead.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": dead.ExpireAt, \"at\": t,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) reply(h Host, t Time, req *Envelope, ack *Envelope) {\n\tack.Src = LockID\n\tack.Dst = req.Src\n\tack.ReqType = req.ReqType\n\tack.ReqID = req.ReqID\n\tack.SendTime = t\n\th.Send(ack)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleAcquire(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tif cached, ok := l.ackCache[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\t// Retransmitted acquire of an already-granted lease: answer again\n\t\t// without consuming a new fence.\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.acquire.replay\", map[string]any{\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, cached)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif l.current != nil {\n\t\tack := &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType:   TypeAcquireBusy,\n\t\t\tResult: ResultBusy,\n\t\t\tReason: \"held\",\n\t\t}\n\t\tack.LeaseID = l.current.ID\n\t\tack.Fence = l.current.Fence\n\t\tack.ExpireAt = l.current.ExpireAt\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"holder\": l.current.Holder, \"fence\": l.current.Fence,\n\t\t})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tlease := &Lease{\n\t\tID:        \"lease-\" + strconv.FormatInt(l.nextFence, 10),\n\t\tHolder:    msg.Src,\n\t\tFence:     l.nextFence,\n\t\tGrantedAt: t,\n\t\tExpireAt:  t + l.ttl,\n\t}\n\tl.nextFence++\n\tl.grants++\n\tl.current = lease\n\tl.history = append(l.history, *lease)\n\n\tack := &Envelope{\n\t\tType: TypeAcquireAck, Result: ResultGranted,\n\t\tLeaseID: lease.ID, Fence: lease.Fence, ExpireAt: lease.ExpireAt,\n\t}\n\tl.ackCache[msg.ReqID] = ack\n\th.SetTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire, lease.ExpireAt)\n\th.Log(\"lock.grant\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": lease.ID, \"fence\": lease.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": lease.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleRenew(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\t// Duplicated renew packet: repeat the recorded answer, never re-extend.\n\tif cached, ok := l.renewCache[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.renew.dedup\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID, \"fence\": cached.fence,\n\t\t})\n\t\tack := &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType: TypeRenewAck, Result: ResultCommitted,\n\t\t\tLeaseID: msg.LeaseID, Fence: cached.fence, ExpireAt: cached.expireAt,\n\t\t}\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif l.current == nil || l.current.Holder != msg.Src || l.current.ID != msg.LeaseID {\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.renew.expired\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID,\n\t\t})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType: TypeRenewErr, Result: ResultExpired, Reason: \"lease expired or unknown\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tnewExpire := t + l.ttl\n\tl.current.ExpireAt = newExpire\n\tl.renewCache[msg.ReqID] = renewResult{fence: l.current.Fence, expireAt: newExpire}\n\t// Move the lease's expiry boundary with the new deadline.\n\th.SetTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire, newExpire)\n\th.Log(\"lock.renew\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": l.current.ID, \"fence\": l.current.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": newExpire,\n\t})\n\tl.reply(h, t, msg, &Envelope{\n\t\tType: TypeRenewAck, Result: ResultCommitted,\n\t\tLeaseID: l.current.ID, Fence: l.current.Fence, ExpireAt: newExpire,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleRelease(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tif cached, ok := l.ackCache[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.release.replay\", map[string]any{\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, cached)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif l.current == nil || l.current.Holder != msg.Src || l.current.ID != msg.LeaseID {\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType: TypeReleaseErr, Result: ResultExpired, Reason: \"not the live lease\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treleased := l.current\n\tl.current = nil\n\th.CancelTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire)\n\tack := &Envelope{Type: TypeReleaseAck, Result: ResultCommitted, Fence: released.Fence}\n\tl.ackCache[msg.ReqID] = ack\n\th.Log(\"lock.release\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": released.ID, \"fence\": released.Fence,\n\t})\n\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns the terminal state for the run report.\nfunc (l *LockService) Snapshot() LockSnapshot {\n\tsnap := LockSnapshot{\n\t\tNodeID:      LockID,\n\t\tNextFence:   l.nextFence,\n\t\tGrants:      l.grants,\n\t\tExpirations: int64(l.expires),\n\t\tHistory:     append([]Lease(nil), l.history...),\n\t}\n\tif l.current != nil {\n\t\tc := *l.current\n\t\tsnap.Current = &c\n\t}\n\treturn snap\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":54,"oldLines":17,"newStart":54,"newLines":21,"lines":["   expires   int64","   history   []Lease"," ","-  // renewCache: ReqID -> granted answer. {"parentUuid":"0079b82a-f6d6-4aea-b8db-3cce3624275a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_pl6c9zk2isqsz6klnn0pr73u","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/resource.go","content":"package sim\n\n// Commit is one accepted write at the resource.\ntype Commit struct {\n\tAt      Time   `json:\"at\"`\n\tClient  string `json:\"client\"`\n\tFence   int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tReqID   string `json:\"req_id\"`\n\tValue   string `json:\"value\"`\n}\n\n// RejectedSubmit records every refused write. The reject reason is the\n// observable proof that the fencing protocol stopped a stale holder.\ntype RejectedSubmit struct {\n\tAt        Time   `json:\"at\"`\n\tClient    string `json:\"client\"`\n\tFence     int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tReqID     string `json:\"req_id\"`\n\tReason    string `json:\"reason\"`\n\tEpochFence int64 `json:\"epoch_fence\"`\n}\n\n// ResourceSnapshot is the post-run state of the protected resource.\ntype ResourceSnapshot struct {\n\tNodeID       string           `json:\"node\"`\n\tCommitted    []Commit         `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected     []RejectedSubmit `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tMaxFence     int64            `json:\"max_fence\"`\n\tHolderFence  int64            `json:\"holder_fence\"`\n}\n\n// Resource is a storage node that only applies writes tagged with the\n// highest fence it has ever seen. {"parentUuid":"4bc4de19-111c-47d8-a030-30b1fa0ef35a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_5fixpe8hz55ttsd9pyf39hqi","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/client.go","content":"package sim\n\nimport \"fmt\"\n\n// Client state.\nconst (\n\tStateIdle        = \"idle\"\n\tStateHasLease    = \"has_lease\"\n\tStateAcquiring   = \"acquiring\"\n\tStateLostLease   = \"lost_lease\"\n\tStateReleased    = \"released\"\n)\n\n// ClientEventSummary is the client-side lifecycle counters used by reports.\ntype ClientEventSummary struct {\n\tID             string `json:\"id\"`\n\tState          string `json:\"state\"`\n\tLeaseID        string `json:\"lease_id\"`\n\tFence          int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tGranted        int64  `json:\"granted\"`\n\tRenewed        int64  `json:\"renewed\"`\n\tRenewFailures  int64  `json:\"renew_failures\"`\n\tAcquireBusy    int64  `json:\"acquire_busy\"`\n\tCommits        int64  `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected       int64  `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tDups           int64  `json:\"deduped\"`\n\tPauses         int64  `json:\"pauses\"`\n\tPausedFor      Time   `json:\"paused_ms_total\"`\n\tHeartbeatsSent int64  `json:\"heartbeats_sent\"`\n}\n\n// Client is a lock-using application node. It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\texpire  Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry    bool\n\tforceAcquire bool\n\tseq      int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. If a previous\n// renewal is already outstanding (heartbeat fired before the ack arrived),\n// this still sends — the service rejects renews against a lease whose state\n// moved on, and the client treats that as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n}\n\n// scheduleHeartbeat re-arms the heartbeat timer at the configured interval.\n// The interval is strictly below the TTL, so a single lost renewal still\n// leaves margin for a second attempt (see scenarios).\nfunc (c *Client) scheduleHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tfence := c.fence\n\tif a.ForceSubmit && fence == 0 {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.force\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"note\": \"zombie submits with last-known fence; state lacks it in this harness\",\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif !a.ForceSubmit && c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treqID := c.nextReqID(\"submit\")\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: res, Type: TypeSubmitReq, ReqType: ReqSubmit,\n\t\tReqID: reqID, Fence: fence, Value: a.Value,\n\t})\n}\n\n// OnPause is invoked by the engine when the freeze begins. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. The client compares \"now\" with\n// the lease expiry it remembers: if the pause outlived the lease, it knows\n// the lock is gone. Scenarios also script the zombie submit explicitly to\n// prove the resource fence independently of this local check.\nfunc (c *Client) OnResume(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state == StateHasLease && t >= c.expire {\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, fmt.Sprintf(\"paused until %d >= lease expire %d\", t, c.expire))\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) snapshotState() {\n\tc.s.State = c.state\n\tc.s.LeaseID = c.leaseID\n\tc.s.Fence = c.fence\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns terminal client counters.\nfunc (c *Client) Snapshot() ClientEventSummary {\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\treturn c.s\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_919577e1641bc81f29734f0f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1339,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":55096,"output_tokens":3040,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_5fixpe8hz55ttsd9pyf39hqi":{"content":"package The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport \"fmt\"\n\n// Client state.\nconst (\n\tStateIdle        = \"idle\"\n\tStateHasLease    = \"has_lease\"\n\tStateAcquiring   = \"acquiring\"\n\tStateLostLease   = \"lost_lease\"\n\tStateReleased    = \"released\"\n)\n\n// ClientEventSummary is the client-side lifecycle counters used by reports.\ntype ClientEventSummary struct {\n\tID             string `json:\"id\"`\n\tState          string `json:\"state\"`\n\tLeaseID        string `json:\"lease_id\"`\n\tFence          int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tGranted        int64  `json:\"granted\"`\n\tRenewed        int64  `json:\"renewed\"`\n\tRenewFailures  int64  `json:\"renew_failures\"`\n\tAcquireBusy    int64  `json:\"acquire_busy\"`\n\tCommits        int64  `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected       int64  `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tDups           int64  `json:\"deduped\"`\n\tPauses         int64  `json:\"pauses\"`\n\tPausedFor      Time   `json:\"paused_ms_total\"`\n\tHeartbeatsSent int64  `json:\"heartbeats_sent\"`\n}\n\n// Client is a lock-using application node. It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\texpire  Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry    bool\n\tforceAcquire bool\n\tseq      int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. If a previous\n// renewal is already outstanding (heartbeat fired before the ack arrived),\n// this still sends — the service rejects renews against a lease whose state\n// moved on, and the client treats that as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n}\n\n// scheduleHeartbeat re-arms the heartbeat timer at the configured interval.\n// The interval is strictly below the TTL, so a single lost renewal still\n// leaves margin for a second attempt (see scenarios).\nfunc (c *Client) scheduleHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tfence := c.fence\n\tif a.ForceSubmit && fence == 0 {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.force\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"note\": \"zombie submits with last-known fence; state lacks it in this harness\",\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif !a.ForceSubmit && c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treqID := c.nextReqID(\"submit\")\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: res, Type: TypeSubmitReq, ReqType: ReqSubmit,\n\t\tReqID: reqID, Fence: fence, Value: a.Value,\n\t})\n}\n\n// OnPause is invoked by the engine when the freeze begins. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. The client compares \"now\" with\n// the lease expiry it remembers: if the pause outlived the lease, it knows\n// the lock is gone. Scenarios also script the zombie submit explicitly to\n// prove the resource fence independently of this local check.\nfunc (c *Client) OnResume(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state == StateHasLease && t >= c.expire {\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, fmt.Sprintf(\"paused until %d >= lease expire %d\", t, c.expire))\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) snapshotState() {\n\tc.s.State = c.state\n\tc.s.LeaseID = c.leaseID\n\tc.s.Fence = c.fence\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns terminal client counters.\nfunc (c *Client) Snapshot() ClientEventSummary {\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\treturn c.s\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":40,"oldLines":7,"newStart":40,"newLines":12,"lines":["   state   string","   leaseID string","   fence   int64","-  expire  Time","+  // lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted.
