It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. It is\n\t// intentionally retained after lease loss: a zombie holder (paused\n\t// process that never observed its expiry) still has its old token in\n\t// memory and will keep presenting it. The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry    bool\n\tforceAcquire bool\n\tseq      int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. If a previous\n// renewal is already outstanding (heartbeat fired before the ack arrived),\n// this still sends — the service rejects renews against a lease whose state\n// moved on, and the client treats that as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n}\n\n// scheduleHeartbeat re-arms the heartbeat timer at the configured interval.\n// The interval is strictly below the TTL, so a single lost renewal still\n// leaves margin for a second attempt (see scenarios).\nfunc (c *Client) scheduleHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tfence := c.fence\n\tif a.ForceSubmit && fence == 0 {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.force\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"note\": \"zombie submits with last-known fence; state lacks it in this harness\",\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif !a.ForceSubmit && c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treqID := c.nextReqID(\"submit\")\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: res, Type: TypeSubmitReq, ReqType: ReqSubmit,\n\t\tReqID: reqID, Fence: fence, Value: a.Value,\n\t})\n}\n\n// OnPause is invoked by the engine when the freeze begins. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. The client compares \"now\" with\n// the lease expiry it remembers: if the pause outlived the lease, it knows\n// the lock is gone. Scenarios also script the zombie submit explicitly to\n// prove the resource fence independently of this local check.\nfunc (c *Client) OnResume(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state == StateHasLease && t >= c.expire {\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, fmt.Sprintf(\"paused until %d >= lease expire %d\", t, c.expire))\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) snapshotState() {\n\tc.s.State = c.state\n\tc.s.LeaseID = c.leaseID\n\tc.s.Fence = c.fence\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns terminal client counters.\nfunc (c *Client) Snapshot() ClientEventSummary {\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\treturn c.s\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":179,"oldLines":6,"newStart":179,"newLines":7,"lines":["   c.state = StateHasLease","   c.leaseID = msg.LeaseID","   c.fence = msg.Fence","+  c.lastFence = msg.Fence","   c.expire = msg.ExpireAt","   c.retry = false","   h.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"01e627e1-9bbb-455a-9977-6680408d2e52","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry    bool\n\tforceAcquire bool\n\tseq      int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. If a previous\n// renewal is already outstanding (heartbeat fired before the ack arrived),\n// this still sends — the service rejects renews against a lease whose state\n// moved on, and the client treats that as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n}\n\n// scheduleHeartbeat re-arms the heartbeat timer at the configured interval.\n// The interval is strictly below the TTL, so a single lost renewal still\n// leaves margin for a second attempt (see scenarios).\nfunc (c *Client) scheduleHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.lastFence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tfence := c.fence\n\tif a.ForceSubmit && fence == 0 {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.force\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"note\": \"zombie submits with last-known fence; state lacks it in this harness\",\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif !a.ForceSubmit && c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treqID := c.nextReqID(\"submit\")\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: res, Type: TypeSubmitReq, ReqType: ReqSubmit,\n\t\tReqID: reqID, Fence: fence, Value: a.Value,\n\t})\n}\n\n// OnPause is invoked by the engine when the freeze begins. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. Scenarios also script the zombie submit explicitly to\n// prove the resource fence independently of this local check.\nfunc (c *Client) OnResume(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state == StateHasLease && t >= c.expire {\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, fmt.Sprintf(\"paused until %d >= lease expire %d\", t, c.expire))\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) snapshotState() {\n\tc.s.State = c.state\n\tc.s.LeaseID = c.leaseID\n\tc.s.Fence = c.fence\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns terminal client counters.\nfunc (c *Client) Snapshot() ClientEventSummary {\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\treturn c.s\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":248,"oldLines":18,"newStart":248,"newLines":26,"lines":["   if res == \"\" {","     res = ResourceID","   }","-  fence := c.fence","-  if a.ForceSubmit && fence == 0 {","-    h.Log(\"client.submit.force\", map[string]any{","-      \"state\": c.state, \"note\": \"zombie submits with last-known fence; state lacks it in this harness\",","-    })","-  }","-  if !a.ForceSubmit && c.state != StateHasLease {","+  switch {","+  case a.ForceSubmit:","+    // Zombie path: submit even though we know we are no longer the","+    // holder, presenting the last token we were granted. It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. If a previous\n// renewal is already outstanding (heartbeat fired before the ack arrived),\n// this still sends — the service rejects renews against a lease whose state\n// moved on, and the client treats that as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n}\n\n// scheduleHeartbeat re-arms the heartbeat timer at the configured interval.\n// The interval is strictly below the TTL, so a single lost renewal still\n// leaves margin for a second attempt (see scenarios).\nfunc (c *Client) scheduleHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.lastFence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tswitch {\n\tcase a.ForceSubmit:\n\t\t// Zombie path: submit even though we know we are no longer the\n\t\t// holder, presenting the last token we were granted. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. The client compares \"now\" with\n// the lease expiry it remembers: if the pause outlived the lease, it knows\n// the lock is gone. Scenarios also script the zombie submit explicitly to\n// prove the resource fence independently of this local check.\nfunc (c *Client) OnResume(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state == StateHasLease && t >= c.expire {\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, fmt.Sprintf(\"paused until %d >= lease expire %d\", t, c.expire))\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) snapshotState() {\n\tc.s.State = c.state\n\tc.s.LeaseID = c.leaseID\n\tc.s.Fence = c.fence\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns terminal client counters.\nfunc (c *Client) Snapshot() ClientEventSummary {\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\treturn c.s\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":48,"oldLines":9,"newStart":48,"newLines":8,"lines":["   expire    Time"," ","   // retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.","-  retry    bool","-  forceAcquire bool","-  seq      int64","+  retry bool","+  seq   int64"," ","   s ClientEventSummary"," }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4c77f134-4010-4e9a-9583-d3c76de376f1","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

Details are a generic map because\n// every node emits its own fields; rows are serialized directly to JSON.\ntype TraceEvent struct {\n\tSeq    int64          `json:\"seq\"`\n\tTime   Time           `json:\"time_ms\"`\n\tNode   string         `json:\"node,omitempty\"`\n\tEvent  string         `json:\"event\"`\n\tDetail map[string]any `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Trace is a Recorder that retains every event in simulation order.\ntype Trace struct {\n\tEvents []TraceEvent `json:\"events\"`\n}\n\nfunc NewTrace() *Trace { return &Trace{} }\n\nfunc (t *Trace) Record(time Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tcp := make(map[string]any, len(detail))\n\tfor k, v := range detail {\n\t\tcp[k] = v\n\t}\n\tt.Events = append(t.Events, TraceEvent{\n\t\tSeq: int64(len(t.Events)) + 1, Time: time, Node: node, Event: event, Detail: cp,\n\t})\n}\n\n// Select returns events matching predicate, keeping order.\nfunc (t *Trace) Select(pred func(TraceEvent) bool) []TraceEvent {\n\tvar out []TraceEvent\n\tfor _, e := range t.Events {\n\t\tif pred(e) {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6db1124b-f310-4e4f-94ef-71d440ebd6b8","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

{\n\t\t\treturn check(\"rejections_only_for_stale_or_fenceless\", false,\n\t\t\t\t\"fence_zero rejection carried nonzero fence\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn int64Field(e, \"fence\")\n\t\tif f <= max {\n\t\t\treturn check(\"no_stale_fence_ever_committed\", false,\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"commit fence %d at t=%d does not exceed %d\", f, e.Time, Check\n\t// this before the fence comparison, since an even newer holder may have\n\t// committed in between the original and its duplicate.\n\tif prev, ok := r.seen[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\tack.Type = TypeSubmitAck\n\t\tack.Result = ResultDuplicate\n\t\tack.Fence = prev.fence","originalFile":"package sim\n\n// Commit is one accepted write at the resource.\ntype Commit struct {\n\tAt      Time   `json:\"at\"`\n\tClient  string `json:\"client\"`\n\tFence   int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tReqID   string `json:\"req_id\"`\n\tValue   string `json:\"value\"`\n}\n\n// RejectedSubmit records every refused write. The reject reason is the\n// observable proof that the fencing protocol stopped a stale holder.\ntype RejectedSubmit struct {\n\tAt        Time   `json:\"at\"`\n\tClient    string `json:\"client\"`\n\tFence     int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tReqID     string `json:\"req_id\"`\n\tReason    string `json:\"reason\"`\n\tEpochFence int64 `json:\"epoch_fence\"`\n}\n\n// ResourceSnapshot is the post-run state of the protected resource.\ntype ResourceSnapshot struct {\n\tNodeID       string           `json:\"node\"`\n\tCommitted    []Commit         `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected     []RejectedSubmit `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tMaxFence     int64            `json:\"max_fence\"`\n\tHolderFence  int64            `json:\"holder_fence\"`\n}\n\n// Resource is a storage node that only applies writes tagged with the\n// highest fence it has ever seen. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"733e82d5-6f60-4bdc-859a-ebe4f5642fb5","timestamp":"2026-09-23T04:00:04.160Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/engine.go","oldString":"\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tRng() *Rng","newString":"\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tResumeNode(id string)\n\tRng() *Rng","originalFile":"// Package sim implements a deterministic, single-process discrete event\n// simulator for a fenced-lease lock: a lock service that hands out leases with\n// monotonically increasing fencing tokens, clients that renew by heartbeat,\n// and a protected resource that rejects writes carrying stale tokens.\n//\n// There are no real sockets, goroutines (for simulation logic) or clocks:\n// every node runs at logical times chosen by the Engine, and message delivery\n// goes through an injectable Network model that can drop, duplicate, delay\n// and reorder packets.\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// Time is logical simulation time, in milliseconds. Time only moves forward.\ntype Time int64\n\n// Kind selects the concrete payload of an Event.\ntype Kind int\n\nconst (\n\tKindMessage Kind = iota // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer               // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction              // a scripted client action runs\n)\n\n// Event is one item in the engine's event queue.\ntype Event struct {\n\tTime Time\n\tKind Kind\n\n\tDst   string // KindMessage / KindAction: target node\n\tMsg   *Envelope\n\tNode  string // KindTimer: owning node\n\tName  string // KindTimer: timer name\n\tAct   *ActionSpec\n\tTimer int64 // KindTimer: per-(node,name) version, for lazy cancellation\n\n\tseq int64 // insertion sequence; tie-breaks equal (Time, Kind) for determinism\n}\n\ntype eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].Time != h[j].Time {\n\t\treturn h[i].Time < h[j].Time\n\t}\n\tif h[i].Kind != h[j].Kind {\n\t\treturn h[i].Kind < h[j].Kind\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)  { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\te := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// Node is implemented by every simulated node (client, lock service, resource).\ntype Node interface {\n\tID() string\n\t// HandleMessage processes a delivered network message.\n\tHandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope)\n\t// OnTimer processes a named timer fired by the engine.\n\tOnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string)\n\t// OnAction processes a scripted scenario action.\n\tOnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec)\n\t// OnPause / OnResume notify the node that it was paused/resumed. Its\n\t// pending timers and inbound messages are frozen over the interval.\n\tOnPause(h Host, t Time)\n\tOnResume(h Host, t Time)\n}\n\n// Host is the engine-facing API a node may call while it is being dispatched.\ntype Host interface {\n\tNow() Time\n\tSend(msg *Envelope)\n\tSetTimer(node, name string, at Time)\n\tCancelTimer(node, name string)\n\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tRng() *Rng\n}\n\n// Recorder receives trace events, in simulation order.\ntype Recorder interface {\n\tRecord(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any)\n}\n\ntype pauseState struct {\n\tpaused bool\n\tuntil  Time\n\theld   []*Event // events whose scheduled time fell inside the pause\n}\n\n// Engine is the simulation kernel.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tnow   Time\n\tqueue eventHeap\n\tseq   int64\n\tevent int64 // processed-event counter, included in every trace record\n\n\tnodes   map[string]Node\n\tpauses  map[string]*pauseState\n\tnet     *Network\n\trec     Recorder\n\trng     *Rng\n\tmaxTime Time\n\n\t// timers holds the current version of each named timer; scheduled events\n\t// carrying an older version are stale and dropped (lazy cancellation).\n\ttimers map[[2]string]timerEntry\n}\n\ntype timerEntry struct {\n\tversion int64\n\tat      Time\n}\n\n// NewEngine builds an engine. seed fully determines probabilistic faults.\nfunc NewEngine(net *Network, rec Recorder, seed uint64, maxTime Time) *Engine {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tnodes:   map[string]Node{},\n\t\tpauses:  map[string]*pauseState{},\n\t\ttimers:  map[[2]string]timerEntry{},\n\t\tnet:     net,\n\t\trec:     rec,\n\t\trng:     NewRng(seed),\n\t\tmaxTime: maxTime,\n\t}\n\theap.Init(&e.queue)\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// AddNode registers a node; must be called before Run.\nfunc (e *Engine) AddNode(n Node) {\n\tif _, dup := e.nodes[n.ID()]; dup {\n\t\tpanic(\"duplicate node \" + n.ID())\n\t}\n\te.nodes[n.ID()] = n\n\te.pauses[n.ID()] = &pauseState{}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Now() Time { return e.now }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Rng() *Rng { return e.rng }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Log(event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\te.record(e.now, \"\", event, detail)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) record(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tif e.rec != nil {\n\t\te.rec.Record(t, node, event, detail)\n\t}\n}\n\n// SetTimer schedules a named timer for node at time at, replacing any current\n// timer with the same (node, name).\nfunc (e *Engine) SetTimer(node, name string, at Time) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tcur := e.timers[k]\n\tcur.version++\n\tcur.at = at\n\te.timers[k] = cur\n\tev := &Event{\n\t\tTime:  at,\n\t\tKind:  KindTimer,\n\t\tNode:  node,\n\t\tName:  name,\n\t\tTimer: cur.version,\n\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) CancelTimer(node, name string) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tif c, ok := e.timers[k]; ok {\n\t\tc.version++\n\t\te.timers[k] = c\n\t}\n}\n\n// nextSeq hands out a monotonic id for deterministic tie-breaking.\nfunc (e *Engine) nextSeq() int64 {\n\te.seq++\n\treturn e.seq\n}\n\n// PauseNode pauses node id: events due before until are held back, then\n// delivered at the resume time. Idempotent: a pause already covering until\n// is a no-op; re-pausing extends the interval.\nfunc (e *Engine) PauseNode(id string, until Time) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\tp.paused = true\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\t\tn.OnPause(e, e.now)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif until > p.until {\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// ResumeNode ends a pause immediately (at h.Now()). If the node is not\n// paused it is a no-op, so resume actions are harmless if the scheduled\n// pause boundary already elapsed.\nfunc (e *Engine) ResumeNode(id string) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif p == nil || !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// dispatch holds or delivers an event depending on the destination pause.\n// pause/resume actions bypass the hold: they control the pause itself and\n// must run even while the node is frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(ev *Event, held bool) {\n\tvar dst string\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\t\tif ev.Act != nil && (ev.Act.Op == OpPause || ev.Act.Op == OpResume) {\n\t\t\theld = false\n\t\t}\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\tdst = ev.Node\n\t}\n\tp := e.pauses[dst]\n\tif p != nil && p.paused && held {\n\t\tp.held = append(p.held, ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.deliver(ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(ev *Event) {\n\tn, ok := e.nodes[ev.Dst]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tn, ok = e.nodes[ev.Node]\n\t}\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.event++\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tn.HandleMessage(e, ev.Time, ev.Msg)\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\t// Drop stale (cancelled/replaced) timer versions.\n\t\tif c, ok := e.timers[[2]string{ev.Node, ev.Name}]; !ok || c.version != ev.Timer {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.OnTimer(e, ev.Time, ev.Name)\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tn.OnAction(e, ev.Time, ev.Act)\n\t}\n}\n\n// scheduleAction enqueues a scripted action from the scenario.\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleAction(a *ActionSpec) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: a.At, Kind: KindAction, Dst: a.Client, Act: a, seq: e.nextSeq()}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// Send hands an outbound message to the network model and schedules its\n// delivery (or deliveries, for duplicates). Messages sent while the sender\n// is paused are dropped: a frozen node cannot produce traffic.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(msg *Envelope) {\n\tmsg.ID = e.nextSeq()\n\tmsg.SendTime = e.now\n\tsenderPaused := e.pauses[msg.Src] != nil && e.pauses[msg.Src].paused\n\toffers := e.net.Transmit(e, msg, senderPaused)\n\tfor _, o := range offers {\n\t\tev := &Event{\n\t\t\tTime:  o.deliverAt,\n\t\t\tKind:  KindMessage,\n\t\t\tDst:   msg.Dst,\n\t\t\tMsg:   o.msg,\n\t\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t\t}\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run drains the event queue until maxTime, then returns the number of events\n// processed (including held-but-never-delivered events at horizon? no: only\n// dispatched events are counted).\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(actions []*ActionSpec) (processed int64, err error) {\n\tfor _, a := range actions {\n\t\tif e.nodes[a.Client] == nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"action at t=%d: unknown client %q\", a.At, a.Client)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.scheduleAction(a)\n\t}\n\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > e.maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Resuming may\n\t\t// enqueue held events at this same time; iterate node ids in sorted\n\t\t// order so multi-node resumes are deterministic (map order is not).\n\t\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\t\tif p.paused && p.until <= e.now {\n\t\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\te.dispatch(ev, true)\n\t\tprocessed = e.event\n\t}\n\n\t// Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.\n\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\tif p.paused {\n\t\t\te.now = p.until\n\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn processed, nil\n}\n\n// pausedNodeIDs returns registered node ids in sorted order.\nfunc (e *Engine) pausedNodeIDs() []string {\n\tids := make([]string, 0, len(e.nodes))\n\tfor id := range e.nodes {\n\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t}\n\tsort.Strings(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":88,"oldLines":6,"newStart":88,"newLines":7,"lines":["   CancelTimer(node, name string)","   Log(event string, detail map[string]any)","   PauseNode(id string, until Time)","+  ResumeNode(id string)","   Rng() *Rng"," }"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fe100809-480e-4600-9e23-7a332b268942","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

Multiple renews may briefly be in flight; the\n// service rejects a renew once the lease moved on, which the client treats\n// as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\t// Absolute cadence: next deadline from \"now\" at the fixed interval,\n\t// which is itself the scheduled deadline.\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\n// armHeartbeat schedules the next fixed-cadence renewal from a reference\n// time (grant time or the instant of an explicit renew).\nfunc (c *Client) armHeartbeat(h Host, from Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, from+c.hb)\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport \"fmt\"\n\n// Client state.\nconst (\n\tStateIdle        = \"idle\"\n\tStateHasLease    = \"has_lease\"\n\tStateAcquiring   = \"acquiring\"\n\tStateLostLease   = \"lost_lease\"\n\tStateReleased    = \"released\"\n)\n\n// ClientEventSummary is the client-side lifecycle counters used by reports.\ntype ClientEventSummary struct {\n\tID             string `json:\"id\"`\n\tState          string `json:\"state\"`\n\tLeaseID        string `json:\"lease_id\"`\n\tFence          int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tGranted        int64  `json:\"granted\"`\n\tRenewed        int64  `json:\"renewed\"`\n\tRenewFailures  int64  `json:\"renew_failures\"`\n\tAcquireBusy    int64  `json:\"acquire_busy\"`\n\tCommits        int64  `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected       int64  `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tDups           int64  `json:\"deduped\"`\n\tPauses         int64  `json:\"pauses\"`\n\tPausedFor      Time   `json:\"paused_ms_total\"`\n\tHeartbeatsSent int64  `json:\"heartbeats_sent\"`\n}\n\n// Client is a lock-using application node. It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. It is\n\t// intentionally retained after lease loss: a zombie holder (paused\n\t// process that never observed its expiry) still has its old token in\n\t// memory and will keep presenting it. The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry bool\n\tseq   int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. If a previous\n// renewal is already outstanding (heartbeat fired before the ack arrived),\n// this still sends — the service rejects renews against a lease whose state\n// moved on, and the client treats that as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n}\n\n// scheduleHeartbeat re-arms the heartbeat timer at the configured interval.\n// The interval is strictly below the TTL, so a single lost renewal still\n// leaves margin for a second attempt (see scenarios).\nfunc (c *Client) scheduleHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.lastFence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. It is\n\t// intentionally retained after lease loss: a zombie holder (paused\n\t// process that never observed its expiry) still has its old token in\n\t// memory and will keep presenting it. The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry bool\n\tseq   int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\t// Fixed-cadence heartbeats do not re-arm on ack (see onHeartbeat).\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. Heartbeats\n// run on a fixed schedule measured from the grant, not from ack arrival:\n// scheduling from the ack would let link latency drift the send times and\n// model the wrong behavior. Multiple renews may briefly be in flight; the\n// service rejects a renew once the lease moved on, which the client treats\n// as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\t// Absolute cadence: next deadline from \"now\" at the fixed interval,\n\t// which is itself the scheduled deadline.\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. It is\n\t// intentionally retained after lease loss: a zombie holder (paused\n\t// process that never observed its expiry) still has its old token in\n\t// memory and will keep presenting it. The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry bool\n\tseq   int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\t// Fixed-cadence heartbeats do not re-arm on ack (see onHeartbeat).\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. Heartbeats\n// run on a fixed schedule measured from the grant, not from ack arrival:\n// scheduling from the ack would let link latency drift the send times and\n// model the wrong behavior. Multiple renews may briefly be in flight; the\n// service rejects a renew once the lease moved on, which the client treats\n// as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\t// Absolute cadence: next deadline from \"now\" at the fixed interval,\n\t// which is itself the scheduled deadline.\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\n// armHeartbeat schedules the next fixed-cadence renewal from a reference\n// time (grant time or the instant of an explicit renew).\nfunc (c *Client) armHeartbeat(h Host, from Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, from+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.lastFence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.armHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tc.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tswitch {\n\tcase a.ForceSubmit:\n\t\t// Zombie path: submit even though we know we are no longer the\n\t\t// holder, presenting the last token we were granted. This is the\n\t\t// write the fencing token exists to block.\n\t\tif c.lastFence == 0 {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.force.skip\", map[string]any{\"reason\": \"never held a lease\"})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\tcase c.state == StateHasLease:\n\tdefault:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfence := c.fence\n\tif a.ForceSubmit {\n\t\tfence = c.lastFence\n\t}\n\treqID := c.nextReqID(\"submit\")\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: res, Type: TypeSubmitReq, ReqType: ReqSubmit,\n\t\tReqID: reqID, Fence: fence, Value: a.Value,\n\t})\n}\n\n// OnPause is invoked by the engine when the freeze begins. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. The client compares \"now\" with\n// the lease expiry it remembers: if the pause outlived the lease, it knows\n// the lock is gone. Scenarios also script the zombie submit explicitly to\n// prove the resource fence independently of this local check.\nfunc (c *Client) OnResume(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state == StateHasLease && t >= c.expire {\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, fmt.Sprintf(\"paused until %d >= lease expire %d\", t, c.expire))\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) snapshotState() {\n\tc.s.State = c.state\n\tc.s.LeaseID = c.leaseID\n\tc.s.Fence = c.fence\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns terminal client counters.\nfunc (c *Client) Snapshot() ClientEventSummary {\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\treturn c.s\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":204,"oldLines":7,"newStart":204,"newLines":8,"lines":["         Src: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,","         ReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,","       })","-      c.scheduleHeartbeat(h, t)","+      // An explicit renew re-anchors the heartbeat cadence.","+      c.armHeartbeat(h, t)","     } else {","       h.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e0c4903b-8b8c-4324-b20e-30a678150110","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

Rules are checked in order\n// and the first match wins, so exact rules can shadow probabilistic behavior.\ntype Rule struct {\n\tType    string  `json:\"type\"`\n\tSrc     string  `json:\"src,omitempty\"`\n\tDst     string  `json:\"dst,omitempty\"`\n\tReqType string  `json:\"req_type,omitempty\"`\n\tMsgType string  `json:\"msg_type,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom    Time    `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tUntil   Time    `json:\"until,omitempty\"`\n\tDelay   Time    `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`\n\tProb    float64 `json:\"prob,omitempty\"` // optional: only apply with probability\n\n\tapplied int\n}\n\n// Match reports whether the rule selects msg at time t.\nfunc (r *Rule) Match(t Time, msg *Envelope) bool {\n\tif r.Src != \"\" && r.Src != \"*\" && r.Src != msg.Src {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.Dst != \"\" && r.Dst != \"*\" && r.Dst != msg.Dst {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.ReqType != \"\" && r.ReqType != msg.ReqType {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.MsgType != \"\" && r.MsgType != msg.Type {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.From != 0 && t < r.From {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.Until != 0 && t > r.Until {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Stats counts what the network did. Counters are part of the run report.\ntype Stats struct {\n\tSent       int64 `json:\"sent\"`\n\tDelivered  int64 `json:\"delivered\"` // scheduled deliveries, including copies\n\tDropped    int64 `json:\"dropped\"`\n\tDuplicated int64 `json:\"duplicated\"`\n\tDelayed    int64 `json:\"delayed\"`\n\tPausedDrop int64 `json:\"paused_sender_dropped\"`\n}\n\n// Network is the transmission model. One link for all node pairs; per-pair\n// behavior is expressed through rules and node filters.\ntype Network struct {\n\t// Baseline link behavior.\n\tMinLatency Time `json:\"min_latency_ms\"`\n\tMaxLatency Time `json:\"max_latency_ms\"`\n\n\t// Probabilistic faults applied when no scripted rule matches.\n\tDropProb      float64 `json:\"drop_prob\"`\n\tDuplicateProb float64 `json:\"duplicate_prob\"`\n\tDuplicateGap  Time    `json:\"duplicate_gap_ms\"`\n\n\tRules []*Rule `json:\"rules\"`\n\n\tStats Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\ntype offer struct {\n\tmsg       *Envelope\n\tdeliverAt Time\n}\n\n// Transmit applies the fault model to one outbound message and returns the\n// delivery offers for the engine to schedule.\nfunc (n *Network) Transmit(h Host, msg *Envelope, senderPaused bool) []offer {\n\trng := h.Rng()\n\tn.Stats.Sent++\n\n\tif senderPaused {\n\t\tn.Stats.Dropped++\n\t\tn.Stats.PausedDrop++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.drop\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"type\": msg.Type, \"src\": msg.Src, \"dst\": msg.Dst,\n\t\t\t\"reason\": \"sender_paused\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tbase := n.baseLatency(rng)\n\tnow := h.Now()\n\tdrop := rng.Bernoulli(n.DropProb)\n\tdup := rng.Bernoulli(n.DuplicateProb)\n\tvar rule *Rule\n\tfor _, r := range n.Rules {\n\t\tif r.Match(now, msg) && (r.Prob == 0 || rng.Bernoulli(r.Prob)) {\n\t\t\trule = r\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif rule != nil {\n\t\tr := rule\n\t\tr.applied++\n\t\tswitch r.Type {\n\t\tcase FaultDrop:\n\t\t\tdrop = true\n\t\tcase FaultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tdup = true\n\t\tcase FaultDelay, FaultReorder:\n\t\t\tbase += r.Delay\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif drop {\n\t\tn.Stats.Dropped++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.drop\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"type\": msg.Type, \"src\": msg.Src, \"dst\": msg.Dst,\n\t\t\t\"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tout := []offer{{msg: msg, deliverAt: now + base}}\n\tn.Stats.Delivered++\n\n\tif dup {\n\t\tgap := n.DuplicateGap\n\t\tif rule != nil && rule.Delay > 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = rule.Delay\n\t\t}\n\t\tif gap <= 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = 50\n\t\t}\n\t\tcopyMsg := *msg\n\t\tcopyMsg.DuplicateOf = msg.ID\n\t\tout = append(out, offer{msg: &copyMsg, deliverAt: now + base + gap})\n\t\tn.Stats.Duplicated++\n\t\tn.Stats.Delivered++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.duplicate\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"copy_gap\": gap,\n\t\t\t\"deliver_at\": now + base + gap, \"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif rule != nil && (rule.Type == FaultDelay || rule.Type == FaultReorder) {\n\t\tn.Stats.Delayed++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.delay\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"extra_ms\": rule.Delay,\n\t\t\t\"deliver_at\": now + base, \"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc matchedRuleName(r *Rule) string {\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\treturn \"probabilistic\"\n\t}\n\treturn r.Type\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) baseLatency(rng *Rng) Time {\n\tmin, max := n.MinLatency, n.MaxLatency\n\tif max <= min {\n\t\tif max < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn 0\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn max\n\t}\n\treturn min + Time(rng.Intn(int(max-min+1)))\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":114,"oldLines":6,"newStart":114,"newLines":11,"lines":[" Rules are checked in order\n// and the first match wins, so exact rules can shadow probabilistic behavior.\ntype Rule struct {\n\tType    string  `json:\"type\"`\n\tSrc     string  `json:\"src,omitempty\"`\n\tDst     string  `json:\"dst,omitempty\"`\n\tReqType string  `json:\"req_type,omitempty\"`\n\tMsgType string  `json:\"msg_type,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom    Time    `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tUntil   Time    `json:\"until,omitempty\"`\n\tDelay   Time    `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`\n\tProb    float64 `json:\"prob,omitempty\"` // optional: only apply with probability\n\n\tapplied int\n}\n\n// Match reports whether the rule selects msg at time t.\nfunc (r *Rule) Match(t Time, msg *Envelope) bool {\n\tif r.Src != \"\" && r.Src != \"*\" && r.Src != msg.Src {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.Dst != \"\" && r.Dst != \"*\" && r.Dst != msg.Dst {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.ReqType != \"\" && r.ReqType != msg.ReqType {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.MsgType != \"\" && r.MsgType != msg.Type {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.From != 0 && t < r.From {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif r.Until != 0 && t > r.Until {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Stats counts what the network did. Counters are part of the run report.\ntype Stats struct {\n\tSent       int64 `json:\"sent\"`\n\tDelivered  int64 `json:\"delivered\"` // scheduled deliveries, including copies\n\tDropped    int64 `json:\"dropped\"`\n\tDuplicated int64 `json:\"duplicated\"`\n\tDelayed    int64 `json:\"delayed\"`\n\tPausedDrop int64 `json:\"paused_sender_dropped\"`\n}\n\n// Network is the transmission model. One link for all node pairs; per-pair\n// behavior is expressed through rules and node filters.\ntype Network struct {\n\t// Baseline link behavior.\n\tMinLatency Time `json:\"min_latency_ms\"`\n\tMaxLatency Time `json:\"max_latency_ms\"`\n\n\t// Probabilistic faults applied when no scripted rule matches.\n\tDropProb      float64 `json:\"drop_prob\"`\n\tDuplicateProb float64 `json:\"duplicate_prob\"`\n\tDuplicateGap  Time    `json:\"duplicate_gap_ms\"`\n\n\tRules []*Rule `json:\"rules\"`\n\n\tStats Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\ntype offer struct {\n\tmsg       *Envelope\n\tdeliverAt Time\n}\n\n// Transmit applies the fault model to one outbound message and returns the\n// delivery offers for the engine to schedule.\nfunc (n *Network) Transmit(h Host, msg *Envelope, senderPaused bool) []offer {\n\trng := h.Rng()\n\tn.Stats.Sent++\n\n\tif senderPaused {\n\t\tn.Stats.Dropped++\n\t\tn.Stats.PausedDrop++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.drop\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"type\": msg.Type, \"src\": msg.Src, \"dst\": msg.Dst,\n\t\t\t\"reason\": \"sender_paused\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tbase := n.baseLatency(rng)\n\tnow := h.Now()\n\tdrop := rng.Bernoulli(n.DropProb)\n\tdup := rng.Bernoulli(n.DuplicateProb)\n\tvar rule *Rule\n\tfor _, r := range n.Rules {\n\t\tif r.Match(now, msg) && (r.Prob == 0 || rng.Bernoulli(r.Prob)) {\n\t\t\trule = r\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif rule != nil {\n\t\tr := rule\n\t\tr.applied++\n\t\tswitch r.Type {\n\t\tcase FaultDrop:\n\t\t\tdrop = true\n\t\tcase FaultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tdup = true\n\t\t\t// The original is also held back when the rule specifies a gap,\n\t\t\t// so a copy cannot beat the intended late arrival.\n\t\t\tif r.Delay > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tbase += r.Delay\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase FaultDelay, FaultReorder:\n\t\t\tbase += r.Delay\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif drop {\n\t\tn.Stats.Dropped++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.drop\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"type\": msg.Type, \"src\": msg.Src, \"dst\": msg.Dst,\n\t\t\t\"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tout := []offer{{msg: msg, deliverAt: now + base}}\n\tn.Stats.Delivered++\n\n\tif dup {\n\t\tgap := n.DuplicateGap\n\t\tif rule != nil && rule.Delay > 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = rule.Delay\n\t\t}\n\t\tif gap <= 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = 50\n\t\t}\n\t\tcopyMsg := *msg\n\t\tcopyMsg.DuplicateOf = msg.ID\n\t\tout = append(out, offer{msg: &copyMsg, deliverAt: now + base + gap})\n\t\tn.Stats.Duplicated++\n\t\tn.Stats.Delivered++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.duplicate\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"copy_gap\": gap,\n\t\t\t\"deliver_at\": now + base + gap, \"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tif rule != nil && (rule.Type == FaultDelay || rule.Type == FaultReorder) {\n\t\tn.Stats.Delayed++\n\t\th.Log(\"net.delay\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"msg\": msg.ID, \"extra_ms\": rule.Delay,\n\t\t\t\"deliver_at\": now + base, \"rule\": matchedRuleName(rule),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc matchedRuleName(r *Rule) string {\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\treturn \"probabilistic\"\n\t}\n\treturn r.Type\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) baseLatency(rng *Rng) Time {\n\tmin, max := n.MinLatency, n.MaxLatency\n\tif max <= min {\n\t\tif max < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn 0\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn max\n\t}\n\treturn min + Time(rng.Intn(int(max-min+1)))\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":137,"oldLines":9,"newStart":137,"newLines":11,"lines":["
