Time only moves forward.\ntype Time int64\n\n// Kind selects the concrete payload of an Event.\ntype Kind int\n\nconst (\n\tKindMessage Kind = iota // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer               // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction              // a scripted client action runs\n)\n\n// Event is one item in the engine's event queue.\ntype Event struct {\n\tTime Time\n\tKind Kind\n\n\tDst   string // KindMessage / KindAction: target node\n\tMsg   *Envelope\n\tNode  string // KindTimer: owning node\n\tName  string // KindTimer: timer name\n\tAct   *ActionSpec\n\tTimer int64 // KindTimer: per-(node,name) version, for lazy cancellation\n\n\tseq int64 // insertion sequence; tie-breaks equal (Time, Kind) for determinism\n}\n\ntype eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].Time != h[j].Time {\n\t\treturn h[i].Time < h[j].Time\n\t}\n\tif h[i].Kind != h[j].Kind {\n\t\treturn h[i].Kind < h[j].Kind\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)  { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\te := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// Node is implemented by every simulated node (client, lock service, resource).\ntype Node interface {\n\tID() string\n\t// HandleMessage processes a delivered network message.\n\tHandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope)\n\t// OnTimer processes a named timer fired by the engine.\n\tOnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string)\n\t// OnAction processes a scripted scenario action.\n\tOnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec)\n\t// OnPause / OnResume notify the node that it was paused/resumed. Its\n\t// pending timers and inbound messages are frozen over the interval.\n\tOnPause(h Host, t Time)\n\tOnResume(h Host, t Time)\n}\n\n// Host is the engine-facing API a node may call while it is being dispatched.\ntype Host interface {\n\tNow() Time\n\tSend(msg *Envelope)\n\tSetTimer(node, name string, at Time)\n\tCancelTimer(node, name string)\n\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tResumeNode(id string)\n\tRng() *Rng\n}\n\n// Recorder receives trace events, in simulation order.\ntype Recorder interface {\n\tRecord(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any)\n}\n\ntype pauseState struct {\n\tpaused bool\n\tuntil  Time\n\theld   []*Event // events whose scheduled time fell inside the pause\n}\n\n// Engine is the simulation kernel.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tnow   Time\n\tqueue eventHeap\n\tseq   int64\n\tevent int64 // processed-event counter, included in every trace record\n\n\tnodes   map[string]Node\n\tpauses  map[string]*pauseState\n\tnet     *Network\n\trec     Recorder\n\trng     *Rng\n\tmaxTime Time\n\n\t// timers holds the current version of each named timer; scheduled events\n\t// carrying an older version are stale and dropped (lazy cancellation).\n\ttimers map[[2]string]timerEntry\n}\n\ntype timerEntry struct {\n\tversion int64\n\tat      Time\n}\n\n// NewEngine builds an engine. seed fully determines probabilistic faults.\nfunc NewEngine(net *Network, rec Recorder, seed uint64, maxTime Time) *Engine {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tnodes:   map[string]Node{},\n\t\tpauses:  map[string]*pauseState{},\n\t\ttimers:  map[[2]string]timerEntry{},\n\t\tnet:     net,\n\t\trec:     rec,\n\t\trng:     NewRng(seed),\n\t\tmaxTime: maxTime,\n\t}\n\theap.Init(&e.queue)\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// AddNode registers a node; must be called before Run.\nfunc (e *Engine) AddNode(n Node) {\n\tif _, dup := e.nodes[n.ID()]; dup {\n\t\tpanic(\"duplicate node \" + n.ID())\n\t}\n\te.nodes[n.ID()] = n\n\te.pauses[n.ID()] = &pauseState{}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Now() Time { return e.now }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Rng() *Rng { return e.rng }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Log(event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\te.record(e.now, \"\", event, detail)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) record(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tif e.rec != nil {\n\t\te.rec.Record(t, node, event, detail)\n\t}\n}\n\n// SetTimer schedules a named timer for node at time at, replacing any current\n// timer with the same (node, name).\nfunc (e *Engine) SetTimer(node, name string, at Time) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tcur := e.timers[k]\n\tcur.version++\n\tcur.at = at\n\te.timers[k] = cur\n\tev := &Event{\n\t\tTime:  at,\n\t\tKind:  KindTimer,\n\t\tNode:  node,\n\t\tName:  name,\n\t\tTimer: cur.version,\n\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) CancelTimer(node, name string) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tif c, ok := e.timers[k]; ok {\n\t\tc.version++\n\t\te.timers[k] = c\n\t}\n}\n\n// nextSeq hands out a monotonic id for deterministic tie-breaking.\nfunc (e *Engine) nextSeq() int64 {\n\te.seq++\n\treturn e.seq\n}\n\n// PauseNode pauses node id: events due before until are held back, then\n// delivered at the resume time. Idempotent: a pause already covering until\n// is a no-op; re-pausing extends the interval.\nfunc (e *Engine) PauseNode(id string, until Time) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\tp.paused = true\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\t\tn.OnPause(e, e.now)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif until > p.until {\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// ResumeNode ends a pause immediately (at h.Now()). If the node is not\n// paused it is a no-op, so resume actions are harmless if the scheduled\n// pause boundary already elapsed.\nfunc (e *Engine) ResumeNode(id string) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif p == nil || !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// dispatch holds or delivers an event depending on the destination pause.\n// pause/resume actions bypass the hold: they control the pause itself and\n// must run even while the node is frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(ev *Event, held bool) {\n\tvar dst string\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\t\tif ev.Act != nil && (ev.Act.Op == OpPause || ev.Act.Op == OpResume) {\n\t\t\theld = false\n\t\t}\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\tdst = ev.Node\n\t}\n\tp := e.pauses[dst]\n\tif p != nil && p.paused && held {\n\t\tp.held = append(p.held, ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.deliver(ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(ev *Event) {\n\tn, ok := e.nodes[ev.Dst]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tn, ok = e.nodes[ev.Node]\n\t}\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.event++\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tn.HandleMessage(e, ev.Time, ev.Msg)\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\t// Drop stale (cancelled/replaced) timer versions.\n\t\tif c, ok := e.timers[[2]string{ev.Node, ev.Name}]; !ok || c.version != ev.Timer {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.OnTimer(e, ev.Time, ev.Name)\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tn.OnAction(e, ev.Time, ev.Act)\n\t}\n}\n\n// scheduleAction enqueues a scripted action from the scenario.\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleAction(a *ActionSpec) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: a.At, Kind: KindAction, Dst: a.Client, Act: a, seq: e.nextSeq()}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// Send hands an outbound message to the network model and schedules its\n// delivery (or deliveries, for duplicates). Messages sent while the sender\n// is paused are dropped: a frozen node cannot produce traffic.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(msg *Envelope) {\n\tmsg.ID = e.nextSeq()\n\tmsg.SendTime = e.now\n\tsenderPaused := e.pauses[msg.Src] != nil && e.pauses[msg.Src].paused\n\toffers := e.net.Transmit(e, msg, senderPaused)\n\tfor _, o := range offers {\n\t\tev := &Event{\n\t\t\tTime:  o.deliverAt,\n\t\t\tKind:  KindMessage,\n\t\t\tDst:   msg.Dst,\n\t\t\tMsg:   o.msg,\n\t\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t\t}\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run drains the event queue until maxTime, then returns the number of events\n// processed (including held-but-never-delivered events at horizon? no: only\n// dispatched events are counted).\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(actions []*ActionSpec) (processed int64, err error) {\n\tfor _, a := range actions {\n\t\tif e.nodes[a.Client] == nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"action at t=%d: unknown client %q\", a.At, a.Client)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.scheduleAction(a)\n\t}\n\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > e.maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Resuming may\n\t\t// enqueue held events at this same time; iterate node ids in sorted\n\t\t// order so multi-node resumes are deterministic (map order is not).\n\t\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\t\tif p.paused && p.until <= e.now {\n\t\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\te.dispatch(ev, true)\n\t\tprocessed = e.event\n\t}\n\n\t// Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.\n\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\tif p.paused {\n\t\t\te.now = p.until\n\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn processed, nil\n}\n\n// pausedNodeIDs returns registered node ids in sorted order.\nfunc (e *Engine) pausedNodeIDs() []string {\n\tids := make([]string, 0, len(e.nodes))\n\tfor id := range e.nodes {\n\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t}\n\tsort.Strings(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":25,"oldLines":6,"newStart":25,"newLines":7,"lines":["   KindMessage Kind = iota // a network message is delivered to Dst","   KindTimer               // a named timer fires for its node","   KindAction              // a scripted client action runs","+  KindWakeup              // internal: a paused node's resume boundary"," )"," "," // Event is one item in the engine's event queue."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"435a7cc4-2630-4dbe-b84d-0b197ff5b6bc","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"102ccde6-05bb-43ca-a7a8-efbd7c44b634","timestamp":"2026-09-23T04:11:21.337Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/engine.go","oldString":"const (\n\tKindMessage Kind = iota // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer               // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction              // a scripted client action runs\n\tKindWakeup              // internal: a paused node's resume boundary\n)","newString":"const (\n\tKindWakeup Kind = iota // internal: a paused node's resume boundary (runs first at t)\n\tKindMessage            // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer              // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction             // a scripted client action runs\n)","originalFile":"// Package sim implements a deterministic, single-process discrete event\n// simulator for a fenced-lease lock: a lock service that hands out leases with\n// monotonically increasing fencing tokens, clients that renew by heartbeat,\n// and a protected resource that rejects writes carrying stale tokens.\n//\n// There are no real sockets, goroutines (for simulation logic) or clocks:\n// every node runs at logical times chosen by the Engine, and message delivery\n// goes through an injectable Network model that can drop, duplicate, delay\n// and reorder packets.\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// Time is logical simulation time, in milliseconds. Time only moves forward.\ntype Time int64\n\n// Kind selects the concrete payload of an Event.\ntype Kind int\n\nconst (\n\tKindMessage Kind = iota // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer               // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction              // a scripted client action runs\n\tKindWakeup              // internal: a paused node's resume boundary\n)\n\n// Event is one item in the engine's event queue.\ntype Event struct {\n\tTime Time\n\tKind Kind\n\n\tDst   string // KindMessage / KindAction: target node\n\tMsg   *Envelope\n\tNode  string // KindTimer: owning node\n\tName  string // KindTimer: timer name\n\tAct   *ActionSpec\n\tTimer int64 // KindTimer: per-(node,name) version, for lazy cancellation\n\n\tseq int64 // insertion sequence; tie-breaks equal (Time, Kind) for determinism\n}\n\ntype eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].Time != h[j].Time {\n\t\treturn h[i].Time < h[j].Time\n\t}\n\tif h[i].Kind != h[j].Kind {\n\t\treturn h[i].Kind < h[j].Kind\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)  { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\te := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// Node is implemented by every simulated node (client, lock service, resource).\ntype Node interface {\n\tID() string\n\t// HandleMessage processes a delivered network message.\n\tHandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope)\n\t// OnTimer processes a named timer fired by the engine.\n\tOnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string)\n\t// OnAction processes a scripted scenario action.\n\tOnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec)\n\t// OnPause / OnResume notify the node that it was paused/resumed. Its\n\t// pending timers and inbound messages are frozen over the interval.\n\tOnPause(h Host, t Time)\n\tOnResume(h Host, t Time)\n}\n\n// Host is the engine-facing API a node may call while it is being dispatched.\ntype Host interface {\n\tNow() Time\n\tSend(msg *Envelope)\n\tSetTimer(node, name string, at Time)\n\tCancelTimer(node, name string)\n\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tResumeNode(id string)\n\tRng() *Rng\n}\n\n// Recorder receives trace events, in simulation order.\ntype Recorder interface {\n\tRecord(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any)\n}\n\ntype pauseState struct {\n\tpaused bool\n\tuntil  Time\n\theld   []*Event // events whose scheduled time fell inside the pause\n}\n\n// Engine is the simulation kernel.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tnow   Time\n\tqueue eventHeap\n\tseq   int64\n\tevent int64 // processed-event counter, included in every trace record\n\n\tnodes   map[string]Node\n\tpauses  map[string]*pauseState\n\tnet     *Network\n\trec     Recorder\n\trng     *Rng\n\tmaxTime Time\n\n\t// timers holds the current version of each named timer; scheduled events\n\t// carrying an older version are stale and dropped (lazy cancellation).\n\ttimers map[[2]string]timerEntry\n}\n\ntype timerEntry struct {\n\tversion int64\n\tat      Time\n}\n\n// NewEngine builds an engine. seed fully determines probabilistic faults.\nfunc NewEngine(net *Network, rec Recorder, seed uint64, maxTime Time) *Engine {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tnodes:   map[string]Node{},\n\t\tpauses:  map[string]*pauseState{},\n\t\ttimers:  map[[2]string]timerEntry{},\n\t\tnet:     net,\n\t\trec:     rec,\n\t\trng:     NewRng(seed),\n\t\tmaxTime: maxTime,\n\t}\n\theap.Init(&e.queue)\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// AddNode registers a node; must be called before Run.\nfunc (e *Engine) AddNode(n Node) {\n\tif _, dup := e.nodes[n.ID()]; dup {\n\t\tpanic(\"duplicate node \" + n.ID())\n\t}\n\te.nodes[n.ID()] = n\n\te.pauses[n.ID()] = &pauseState{}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Now() Time { return e.now }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Rng() *Rng { return e.rng }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Log(event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\te.record(e.now, \"\", event, detail)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) record(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tif e.rec != nil {\n\t\te.rec.Record(t, node, event, detail)\n\t}\n}\n\n// SetTimer schedules a named timer for node at time at, replacing any current\n// timer with the same (node, name).\nfunc (e *Engine) SetTimer(node, name string, at Time) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tcur := e.timers[k]\n\tcur.version++\n\tcur.at = at\n\te.timers[k] = cur\n\tev := &Event{\n\t\tTime:  at,\n\t\tKind:  KindTimer,\n\t\tNode:  node,\n\t\tName:  name,\n\t\tTimer: cur.version,\n\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) CancelTimer(node, name string) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tif c, ok := e.timers[k]; ok {\n\t\tc.version++\n\t\te.timers[k] = c\n\t}\n}\n\n// nextSeq hands out a monotonic id for deterministic tie-breaking.\nfunc (e *Engine) nextSeq() int64 {\n\te.seq++\n\treturn e.seq\n}\n\n// PauseNode pauses node id: events due before until are held back, then\n// delivered at the resume time. Idempotent: a pause already covering until\n// is a no-op; re-pausing extends the interval.\nfunc (e *Engine) PauseNode(id string, until Time) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\tp.paused = true\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\t\tn.OnPause(e, e.now)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif until > p.until {\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// ResumeNode ends a pause immediately (at h.Now()). If the node is not\n// paused it is a no-op, so resume actions are harmless if the scheduled\n// pause boundary already elapsed.\nfunc (e *Engine) ResumeNode(id string) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif p == nil || !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// dispatch holds or delivers an event depending on the destination pause.\n// pause/resume actions bypass the hold: they control the pause itself and\n// must run even while the node is frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(ev *Event, held bool) {\n\tvar dst string\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\t\tif ev.Act != nil && (ev.Act.Op == OpPause || ev.Act.Op == OpResume) {\n\t\t\theld = false\n\t\t}\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\tdst = ev.Node\n\t}\n\tp := e.pauses[dst]\n\tif p != nil && p.paused && held {\n\t\tp.held = append(p.held, ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.deliver(ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(ev *Event) {\n\tn, ok := e.nodes[ev.Dst]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tn, ok = e.nodes[ev.Node]\n\t}\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.event++\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tn.HandleMessage(e, ev.Time, ev.Msg)\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\t// Drop stale (cancelled/replaced) timer versions.\n\t\tif c, ok := e.timers[[2]string{ev.Node, ev.Name}]; !ok || c.version != ev.Timer {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.OnTimer(e, ev.Time, ev.Name)\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tn.OnAction(e, ev.Time, ev.Act)\n\t}\n}\n\n// scheduleAction enqueues a scripted action from the scenario.\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleAction(a *ActionSpec) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: a.At, Kind: KindAction, Dst: a.Client, Act: a, seq: e.nextSeq()}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// Send hands an outbound message to the network model and schedules its\n// delivery (or deliveries, for duplicates). Messages sent while the sender\n// is paused are dropped: a frozen node cannot produce traffic.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(msg *Envelope) {\n\tmsg.ID = e.nextSeq()\n\tmsg.SendTime = e.now\n\tsenderPaused := e.pauses[msg.Src] != nil && e.pauses[msg.Src].paused\n\toffers := e.net.Transmit(e, msg, senderPaused)\n\tfor _, o := range offers {\n\t\tev := &Event{\n\t\t\tTime:  o.deliverAt,\n\t\t\tKind:  KindMessage,\n\t\t\tDst:   msg.Dst,\n\t\t\tMsg:   o.msg,\n\t\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t\t}\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run drains the event queue until maxTime, then returns the number of events\n// processed (including held-but-never-delivered events at horizon? no: only\n// dispatched events are counted).\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(actions []*ActionSpec) (processed int64, err error) {\n\tfor _, a := range actions {\n\t\tif e.nodes[a.Client] == nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"action at t=%d: unknown client %q\", a.At, a.Client)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.scheduleAction(a)\n\t}\n\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > e.maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Resuming may\n\t\t// enqueue held events at this same time; iterate node ids in sorted\n\t\t// order so multi-node resumes are deterministic (map order is not).\n\t\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\t\tif p.paused && p.until <= e.now {\n\t\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\te.dispatch(ev, true)\n\t\tprocessed = e.event\n\t}\n\n\t// Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.\n\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\tif p.paused {\n\t\t\te.now = p.until\n\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn processed, nil\n}\n\n// pausedNodeIDs returns registered node ids in sorted order.\nfunc (e *Engine) pausedNodeIDs() []string {\n\tids Time only moves forward.\ntype Time int64\n\n// Kind selects the concrete payload of an Event.\ntype Kind int\n\nconst (\n\tKindWakeup Kind = iota // internal: a paused node's resume boundary (runs first at t)\n\tKindMessage            // a network message is delivered to Dst\n\tKindTimer              // a named timer fires for its node\n\tKindAction             // a scripted client action runs\n)\n\n// Event is one item in the engine's event queue.\ntype Event struct {\n\tTime Time\n\tKind Kind\n\n\tDst   string // KindMessage / KindAction: target node\n\tMsg   *Envelope\n\tNode  string // KindTimer: owning node\n\tName  string // KindTimer: timer name\n\tAct   *ActionSpec\n\tTimer int64 // KindTimer: per-(node,name) version, for lazy cancellation\n\n\tseq int64 // insertion sequence; tie-breaks equal (Time, Kind) for determinism\n}\n\ntype eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].Time != h[j].Time {\n\t\treturn h[i].Time < h[j].Time\n\t}\n\tif h[i].Kind != h[j].Kind {\n\t\treturn h[i].Kind < h[j].Kind\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)  { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\te := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// Node is implemented by every simulated node (client, lock service, resource).\ntype Node interface {\n\tID() string\n\t// HandleMessage processes a delivered network message.\n\tHandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope)\n\t// OnTimer processes a named timer fired by the engine.\n\tOnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string)\n\t// OnAction processes a scripted scenario action.\n\tOnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec)\n\t// OnPause / OnResume notify the node that it was paused/resumed. Its\n\t// pending timers and inbound messages are frozen over the interval.\n\tOnPause(h Host, t Time)\n\tOnResume(h Host, t Time)\n}\n\n// Host is the engine-facing API a node may call while it is being dispatched.\ntype Host interface {\n\tNow() Time\n\tSend(msg *Envelope)\n\tSetTimer(node, name string, at Time)\n\tCancelTimer(node, name string)\n\tLog(event string, detail map[string]any)\n\tPauseNode(id string, until Time)\n\tResumeNode(id string)\n\tRng() *Rng\n}\n\n// Recorder receives trace events, in simulation order.\ntype Recorder interface {\n\tRecord(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any)\n}\n\ntype pauseState struct {\n\tpaused bool\n\tuntil  Time\n\theld   []*Event // events whose scheduled time fell inside the pause\n}\n\n// Engine is the simulation kernel.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tnow   Time\n\tqueue eventHeap\n\tseq   int64\n\tevent int64 // processed-event counter, included in every trace record\n\n\tnodes   map[string]Node\n\tpauses  map[string]*pauseState\n\tnet     *Network\n\trec     Recorder\n\trng     *Rng\n\tmaxTime Time\n\n\t// timers holds the current version of each named timer; scheduled events\n\t// carrying an older version are stale and dropped (lazy cancellation).\n\ttimers map[[2]string]timerEntry\n}\n\ntype timerEntry struct {\n\tversion int64\n\tat      Time\n}\n\n// NewEngine builds an engine. seed fully determines probabilistic faults.\nfunc NewEngine(net *Network, rec Recorder, seed uint64, maxTime Time) *Engine {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tnodes:   map[string]Node{},\n\t\tpauses:  map[string]*pauseState{},\n\t\ttimers:  map[[2]string]timerEntry{},\n\t\tnet:     net,\n\t\trec:     rec,\n\t\trng:     NewRng(seed),\n\t\tmaxTime: maxTime,\n\t}\n\theap.Init(&e.queue)\n\treturn e\n}\n\n// AddNode registers a node; must be called before Run.\nfunc (e *Engine) AddNode(n Node) {\n\tif _, dup := e.nodes[n.ID()]; dup {\n\t\tpanic(\"duplicate node \" + n.ID())\n\t}\n\te.nodes[n.ID()] = n\n\te.pauses[n.ID()] = &pauseState{}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Now() Time { return e.now }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Rng() *Rng { return e.rng }\n\nfunc (e *Engine) Log(event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\te.record(e.now, \"\", event, detail)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) record(t Time, node, event string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tif e.rec != nil {\n\t\te.rec.Record(t, node, event, detail)\n\t}\n}\n\n// SetTimer schedules a named timer for node at time at, replacing any current\n// timer with the same (node, name).\nfunc (e *Engine) SetTimer(node, name string, at Time) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tcur := e.timers[k]\n\tcur.version++\n\tcur.at = at\n\te.timers[k] = cur\n\tev := &Event{\n\t\tTime:  at,\n\t\tKind:  KindTimer,\n\t\tNode:  node,\n\t\tName:  name,\n\t\tTimer: cur.version,\n\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) CancelTimer(node, name string) {\n\tk := [2]string{node, name}\n\tif c, ok := e.timers[k]; ok {\n\t\tc.version++\n\t\te.timers[k] = c\n\t}\n}\n\n// nextSeq hands out a monotonic id for deterministic tie-breaking.\nfunc (e *Engine) nextSeq() int64 {\n\te.seq++\n\treturn e.seq\n}\n\n// PauseNode pauses node id: events due before until are held back, then\n// delivered at the resume time. Idempotent: a pause already covering until\n// is a no-op; re-pausing extends the interval.\nfunc (e *Engine) PauseNode(id string, until Time) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\tp.paused = true\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\t\tn.OnPause(e, e.now)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif until > p.until {\n\t\tp.until = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// ResumeNode ends a pause immediately (at h.Now()). If the node is not\n// paused it is a no-op, so resume actions are harmless if the scheduled\n// pause boundary already elapsed.\nfunc (e *Engine) ResumeNode(id string) {\n\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\tif p == nil || !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n}\n\n// resumeNode ends a pause and queues held events for delivery now, preserving\n// their original order.\nfunc (e *Engine) resumeNode(t Time, p *pauseState, id string) {\n\tif !p.paused {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.paused = false\n\tp.until = 0\n\theld := p.held\n\tp.held = nil\n\tfor _, ev := range held {\n\t\tev.Time = t\n\t\tev.seq = e.nextSeq()\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n\tif n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {\n\t\tn.OnResume(e, t)\n\t}\n\te.record(t, id, \"node.resume\", map[string]any{\"held_delivered\": len(held)})\n}\n\n// dispatch holds or delivers an event depending on the destination pause.\n// pause/resume actions bypass the hold: they control the pause itself and\n// must run even while the node is frozen.\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(ev *Event, held bool) {\n\tvar dst string\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tdst = ev.Dst\n\t\tif ev.Act != nil && (ev.Act.Op == OpPause || ev.Act.Op == OpResume) {\n\t\t\theld = false\n\t\t}\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\tdst = ev.Node\n\t}\n\tp := e.pauses[dst]\n\tif p != nil && p.paused && held {\n\t\tp.held = append(p.held, ev)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.deliver(ev)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) deliver(ev *Event) {\n\tn, ok := e.nodes[ev.Dst]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tn, ok = e.nodes[ev.Node]\n\t}\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.event++\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase KindMessage:\n\t\tn.HandleMessage(e, ev.Time, ev.Msg)\n\tcase KindTimer:\n\t\t// Drop stale (cancelled/replaced) timer versions.\n\t\tif c, ok := e.timers[[2]string{ev.Node, ev.Name}]; !ok || c.version != ev.Timer {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.OnTimer(e, ev.Time, ev.Name)\n\tcase KindAction:\n\t\tn.OnAction(e, ev.Time, ev.Act)\n\t}\n}\n\n// scheduleAction enqueues a scripted action from the scenario.\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleAction(a *ActionSpec) {\n\tev := &Event{Time: a.At, Kind: KindAction, Dst: a.Client, Act: a, seq: e.nextSeq()}\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// Send hands an outbound message to the network model and schedules its\n// delivery (or deliveries, for duplicates). Messages sent while the sender\n// is paused are dropped: a frozen node cannot produce traffic.\nfunc (e *Engine) Send(msg *Envelope) {\n\tmsg.ID = e.nextSeq()\n\tmsg.SendTime = e.now\n\tsenderPaused := e.pauses[msg.Src] != nil && e.pauses[msg.Src].paused\n\toffers := e.net.Transmit(e, msg, senderPaused)\n\tfor _, o := range offers {\n\t\tev := &Event{\n\t\t\tTime:  o.deliverAt,\n\t\t\tKind:  KindMessage,\n\t\t\tDst:   msg.Dst,\n\t\t\tMsg:   o.msg,\n\t\t\tseq:   e.nextSeq(),\n\t\t}\n\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run drains the event queue until maxTime, then returns the number of events\n// processed (including held-but-never-delivered events at horizon? no: only\n// dispatched events are counted).\nfunc (e *Engine) Run(actions []*ActionSpec) (processed int64, err error) {\n\tfor _, a := range actions {\n\t\tif e.nodes[a.Client] == nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"action at t=%d: unknown client %q\", a.At, a.Client)\n\t\t}\n\t\te.scheduleAction(a)\n\t}\n\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*Event)\n\t\tif ev.Time > e.maxTime {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.Time\n\n\t\t// Complete any pause whose resume time has arrived. Resuming may\n\t\t// enqueue held events at this same time; iterate node ids in sorted\n\t\t// order so multi-node resumes are deterministic (map order is not).\n\t\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\t\tif p.paused && p.until <= e.now {\n\t\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\te.dispatch(ev, true)\n\t\tprocessed = e.event\n\t}\n\n\t// Nodes still paused at horizon are resumed for snapshot purposes only.\n\tfor _, id := range e.pausedNodeIDs() {\n\t\tp := e.pauses[id]\n\t\tif p.paused {\n\t\t\te.now = p.until\n\t\t\te.resumeNode(e.now, p, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn processed, nil\n}\n\n// pausedNodeIDs returns registered node ids in sorted order.\nfunc (e *Engine) pausedNodeIDs() []string {\n\tids := make([]string, 0, len(e.nodes))\n\tfor id := range e.nodes {\n\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t}\n\tsort.Strings(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":210,"oldLines":6,"newStart":210,"newLines":11,"lines":["     if n, ok := e.nodes[id]; ok {","       n.OnPause(e, e.now)","     }","+    // Schedule the exact resume boundary so the node wakes at `until`","+    // even if no other event happens at that time.","+    heap.Push(&e.queue, &Event{","+      Time: until, Kind: KindWakeup, Node: id, Dst: id, seq: e.nextSeq(),","+    })","     e.record(e.now, id, \"node.pause\", map[string]any{\"until\": until, \"duration\": until - e.now})","     return","   }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4125f2d0-8cbb-46c0-9c6b-6f32952f2655","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\t\"time\"\n)\n\n// helper: run a scenario from inline JSON.\nfunc runJSON(t *testing.T, data string) *Result {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tres, err := RunJSON([]byte(data))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"RunJSON: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc assertAllInvariants(t *testing.T, res *Result) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tfor _, c := range res.Report.Invariants {\n\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"invariant %q failed: %s\", c.Name, c.Detail)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestScenarioRenewalLost: dropped renewals force a lease takeover, and the\n// deposed holder's later write with its old fence is rejected by the\n// resource even though the lock takeover happened without the holder's\n// involvement.\nfunc TestScenarioRenewalLost(t *testing.T) {\n\tdata := `{\n\t  \"name\":\"t-renewal-lost\",\"seed\":1,\"ttl_ms\":2000,\"heartbeat_ms\":700,\n\t  \"retry_gap_ms\":200,\"end_ms\":5000,\n\t  \"network\":{\"min_latency_ms\":10,\"max_latency_ms\":10,\"rules\":[\n\t    {\"type\":\"drop\",\"src\":\"A\",\"dst\":\"L\",\"req_type\":\"renew\",\"from\":710,\"until\":1430}\n\t  ]},\n\t  \"clients\":[{\"id\":\"A\"},{\"id\":\"B\"}],\n\t  \"actions\":[\n\t    {\"at_ms\":0,\"client\":\"A\",\"op\":\"acquire\"},\n\t    {\"at_ms\":300,\"client\":\"A\",\"op\":\"submit\",\"value\":\"a1\",\"resource\":\"R\"},\n\t    {\"at_ms\":1600,\"client\":\"B\",\"op\":\"acquire\",\"retry\":true},\n\t    {\"at_ms\":2600,\"client\":\"B\",\"op\":\"submit\",\"value\":\"b2\",\"resource\":\"R\"},\n\t    {\"at_ms\":3500,\"client\":\"A\",\"op\":\"submit\",\"value\":\"zombie\",\"resource\":\"R\",\"force_submit\":true}\n\t  ]\n\t}`\n\tres := runJSON(t, data)\n\tassertAllInvariants(t, res)\n\trep := res.Report\n\n\tif rep.Lock.Grants != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"want 2 grants, got %d\", rep.Lock.Grants)\n\t}\n\tif rep.Lock.Expirations != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"want 1 expiration, got %d\", rep.Lock.Expirations)\n\t}\n\tcommits := rep.Resource.Committed\n\tif len(commits) != 2 || commits[0].Fence != 1 || commits[1].Fence != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"want commits fences [1 2], got %+v\", commits)\n\t}\n\tif len(rep.Resource.Rejected) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"want exactly 1 stale rejection, got %+v\", rep.Resource.Rejected)\n\t}\n\tif rep.Resource.Rejected[0].Fence != 1 || rep.Resource.Rejected[0].Reason != ResultStaleFence {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"want stale fence 1 rejection, got %+v\", rep.Resource.Rejected[0])\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestScenarioPauseLongerThanTTL: a frozen client cannot renew; another\n// client acquires while it is frozen; the zombie write after resume is\n// rejected by the fence on the resource.\nfunc TestScenarioPauseLongerThanTTL(t *testing.T) {\n\tdata := `{\n\t  \"name\":\"t-pause\",\"seed\":2,\"ttl_ms\":1000,\"heartbeat_ms\":400,\n\t  \"retry_gap_ms\":200,\"end_ms\":5000,\n\t  \"network\":{\"min_latency_ms\":10,\"max_latency_ms\":10,\"rules\":[]},\n\t  \"clients\":[{\"id\":\"A\"},{\"id\":\"B\"}],\n\t  \"actions\":[\n\t {\"at_ms\":3500,\"client\":\"A\",\"op\":\"submit\",\"value\":\"zombie\",\"resource\":\"R\",\"force_submit\":true}\n\t  ]\n\t}`\n\tres := runJSON(t, data)\n\tassertAllInvariants(t, res)\n\trep := commits)\n\t}\n\tif len(rep.Resource.Rejected) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"want exactly 1 stale rejection, got %+v\", rep.Resource.Rejected)\n\t}\n\tif rep.Resource.Rejected[0].Fence != 1 || Here\n// we simply assert a 6000ms scenario completes in well under real 6000ms.\nfunc TestClockDoesNotUseWallTime(t *testing.T) {\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(\"..\", \"..\", \"scenarios\", \"2-pause-longer-than-ttl.json\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Skip(err)\n\t}\n\tstart := time.Now()\n\tres, err := RunJSON(data)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif d := time.Since(start); d > 250*time.Millisecond {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"simulation took %v real time\", d)\n\t}\n\tif res.Report.EndTime < 3000 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"modeled end time too small: %d\", res.Report.EndTime)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestScenarioFilesOnDisk: every shipped scenario runs with all invariants.\nfunc TestScenarioFilesOnDisk(t *testing.T) {\n\tdir := filepath.Join(\"..\", \"..\", \"scenarios\")\n\tfiles, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, \"*.json\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif len(files) < 4 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected >=4 scenario files, got %d\", len(files))\n\t}\n\tfor _, f := range files {\n\t\traw, err := os.ReadFile(f)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tres, err := RunJSON(raw)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: %v\", filepath.Base(f), err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tassertAllInvariants(t, res)\n\t\tif !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(f), \"happy\") {\n\t\t\tif len(res.Report.Resource.Rejected) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s: hostile scenario produced no resource rejections\", filepath.Base(f))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6b87f6db-3f5f-4107-9b71-3a6ec42e9962","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

This is the\n\t\t// write the fencing token exists to block.\n\t\tfence = c.lastFence\n\tcase a.ForceSubmit:\n\t\t// A node that imagines it holds a lock it was never granted carries\n\t\t// no token at all: fence 0, which the resource also rejects.\n\t\tfence = 0\n\tcase c.state == StateHasLease:\n\t\tfence = c.fence\n\tdefault:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport \"fmt\"\n\n// Client state.\nconst (\n\tStateIdle        = \"idle\"\n\tStateHasLease    = \"has_lease\"\n\tStateAcquiring   = \"acquiring\"\n\tStateLostLease   = \"lost_lease\"\n\tStateReleased    = \"released\"\n)\n\n// ClientEventSummary is the client-side lifecycle counters used by reports.\ntype ClientEventSummary struct {\n\tID             string `json:\"id\"`\n\tState          string `json:\"state\"`\n\tLeaseID        string `json:\"lease_id\"`\n\tFence          int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tGranted        int64  `json:\"granted\"`\n\tRenewed        int64  `json:\"renewed\"`\n\tRenewFailures  int64  `json:\"renew_failures\"`\n\tAcquireBusy    int64  `json:\"acquire_busy\"`\n\tCommits        int64  `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected       int64  `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tDups           int64  `json:\"deduped\"`\n\tPauses         int64  `json:\"pauses\"`\n\tPausedFor      Time   `json:\"paused_ms_total\"`\n\tHeartbeatsSent int64  `json:\"heartbeats_sent\"`\n}\n\n// Client is a lock-using application node. It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. It is\n\t// intentionally retained after lease loss: a zombie holder (paused\n\t// process that never observed its expiry) still has its old token in\n\t// memory and will keep presenting it. The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry bool\n\tseq   int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\t// Fixed-cadence heartbeats do not re-arm on ack (see onHeartbeat).\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. Heartbeats\n// run on a fixed schedule measured from the grant, not from ack arrival:\n// scheduling from the ack would let link latency drift the send times and\n// model the wrong behavior. Multiple renews may briefly be in flight; the\n// service rejects a renew once the lease moved on, which the client treats\n// as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\t// Absolute cadence: next deadline from \"now\" at the fixed interval,\n\t// which is itself the scheduled deadline.\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\n// armHeartbeat schedules the next fixed-cadence renewal from a reference\n// time (grant time or the instant of an explicit renew).\nfunc (c *Client) armHeartbeat(h Host, from Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, from+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.lastFence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.armHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t// An explicit renew re-anchors the heartbeat cadence.\n\t\t\tc.armHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tswitch {\n\tcase a.ForceSubmit:\n\t\t// Zombie path: submit even though we know we are no longer the\n\t\t// holder, presenting the last token we were granted. This is the\n\t\t// write the fencing token exists to block.\n\t\tif c.lastFence == 0 {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.force.skip\", map[string]any{\"reason\": \"never held a lease\"})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\tcase c.state == StateHasLease:\n\tdefault:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfence := c.fence\n\tif a.ForceSubmit {\n\t\tfence = c.lastFence\n\t}\n\treqID := c.nextReqID(\"submit\")\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: res, Type: TypeSubmitReq, ReqType: ReqSubmit,\n\t\tReqID: reqID, Fence: fence, Value: a.Value,\n\t})\n}\n\n// OnPause is invoked by the engine when the freeze begins. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. The client compares \"now\" with\n// the lease expiry it remembers: if the pause outlived the lease, it knows\n// the lock is gone. Scenarios also script the zombie submit explicitly to\n// prove the resource fence independently of this local check.\nfunc (c *Client) OnResume(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state == StateHasLease && t >= c.expire {\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, fmt.Sprintf(\"paused until %d >= lease expire %d\", t, c.expire))\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) snapshotState() {\n\tc.s.State = c.state\n\tc.s.LeaseID = c.leaseID\n\tc.s.Fence = c.fence\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns terminal client counters.\nfunc (c *Client) Snapshot() ClientEventSummary {\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\treturn c.s\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":252,"oldLines":25,"newStart":252,"newLines":23,"lines":["     res = ResourceID","   }","   switch {","-  case a.ForceSubmit:","+  case a.ForceSubmit && c.lastFence != 0:","     // Zombie path: submit even though we know we are no longer the","     // holder, presenting the last token we were granted. It renews its lease by periodic\n// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\ntype Client struct {\n\tid        string\n\thb        Time\n\tretryGap  Time\n\n\tstate   string\n\tleaseID string\n\tfence   int64\n\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. It is\n\t// intentionally retained after lease loss: a zombie holder (paused\n\t// process that never observed its expiry) still has its old token in\n\t// memory and will keep presenting it. The resource must reject it.\n\tlastFence int64\n\texpire    Time\n\n\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n\tretry bool\n\tseq   int64\n\n\ts ClientEventSummary\n}\n\nfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n\tc.s.ID = id\n\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n\n// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\nfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n\tc.seq++\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n\th.Send(e)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tswitch msg.Type {\n\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n\t\t// Fixed-cadence heartbeats do not re-arm on ack (see onHeartbeat).\n\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n\n\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n\t\tc.fence = 0\n\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n\n\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n\n\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tswitch name {\n\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. Heartbeats\n// run on a fixed schedule measured from the grant, not from ack arrival:\n// scheduling from the ack would let link latency drift the send times and\n// model the wrong behavior. Multiple renews may briefly be in flight; the\n// service rejects a renew once the lease moved on, which the client treats\n// as lease loss.\nfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t})\n\t// Absolute cadence: next deadline from \"now\" at the fixed interval,\n\t// which is itself the scheduled deadline.\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, t+c.hb)\n}\n\n// armHeartbeat schedules the next fixed-cadence renewal from a reference\n// time (grant time or the instant of an explicit renew).\nfunc (c *Client) armHeartbeat(h Host, from Time) {\n\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat, from+c.hb)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) loseLease(h Host, t Time, reason string) {\n\tif c.state != StateHasLease && c.state != StateAcquiring {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.state = StateLostLease\n\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n\tc.fence = 0\n\tc.expire = 0\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.snapshotState()\n\th.Log(\"client.lost_lease\", map[string]any{\"reason\": reason})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) onGranted(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tc.s.Granted++\n\tc.state = StateHasLease\n\tc.leaseID = msg.LeaseID\n\tc.fence = msg.Fence\n\tc.lastFence = msg.Fence\n\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n\tc.retry = false\n\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry)\n\tc.armHeartbeat(h, t)\n\th.Log(\"client.granted\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"lease_id\": msg.LeaseID, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) OnAction(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tswitch a.Op {\n\tcase OpAcquire:\n\t\tc.retry = a.Retry\n\t\tc.state = StateAcquiring\n\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n\tcase OpRenew:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.s.HeartbeatsSent++\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeRenewReq, ReqType: ReqRenew,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"renew\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t// An explicit renew re-anchors the heartbeat cadence.\n\t\t\tc.armHeartbeat(h, t)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpSubmit:\n\t\tc.doSubmit(h, t, a)\n\tcase OpRelease:\n\t\tif c.state == StateHasLease {\n\t\t\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\t\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeReleaseReq, ReqType: ReqRelease,\n\t\t\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"release\"), LeaseID: c.leaseID, Fence: c.fence,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\th.Log(\"client.action.skip\", map[string]any{\"op\": a.Op, \"state\": c.state})\n\t\t}\n\tcase OpPause:\n\t\tc.s.Pauses++\n\t\tc.s.PausedFor += a.Duration\n\t\th.Log(\"client.pause.request\", map[string]any{\"duration\": a.Duration, \"until\": t + a.Duration})\n\t\th.PauseNode(c.id, t+a.Duration)\n\tcase OpResume:\n\t\th.ResumeNode(c.id)\n\tcase OpNote:\n\t\th.Log(\"note\", map[string]any{\"value\": a.Value})\n\t}\n\tc.snapshotState()\n}\n\nfunc (c *Client) doAcquire(h Host, t Time) {\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: LockID, Type: TypeAcquireReq, ReqType: ReqAcquire,\n\t\tReqID: c.nextReqID(\"acquire\"),\n\t})\n}\n\n// doSubmit writes to the protected resource using the fence of the lease the\n// client believes it holds. A paused-then-resumed client whose lease expired\n// has already forgotten its fence, unless ForceSubmit is set: that models a\n// zombie that never learned it was deposed and keeps using the old fence.\n// Either way the resource decides.\nfunc (c *Client) doSubmit(h Host, t Time, a *ActionSpec) {\n\tres := a.Resource\n\tif res == \"\" {\n\t\tres = ResourceID\n\t}\n\tswitch {\n\tcase a.ForceSubmit && c.lastFence != 0:\n\t\t// Zombie path: submit even though we know we are no longer the\n\t\t// holder, presenting the last token we were granted. This is the\n\t\t// write the fencing token exists to block.\n\t\tfence = c.lastFence\n\tcase a.ForceSubmit:\n\t\t// A node that imagines it holds a lock it was never granted carries\n\t\t// no token at all: fence 0, which the resource also rejects.\n\t\tfence = 0\n\tcase c.state == StateHasLease:\n\t\tfence = c.fence\n\tdefault:\n\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.refused_locally\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"state\": c.state, \"value\": a.Value,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treqID := c.nextReqID(\"submit\")\n\tc.send(h, &Envelope{\n\t\tSrc: c.id, Dst: res, Type: TypeSubmitReq, ReqType: ReqSubmit,\n\t\tReqID: reqID, Fence: fence, Value: a.Value,\n\t})\n}\n\n// OnPause is invoked by the engine when the freeze begins. The client's\n// heartbeat timer and inbound messages are frozen alongside it; nothing runs\n// until resume, so no renewal can escape.\nfunc (c *Client) OnPause(h Host, t Time) {}\n\n// OnResume runs the moment the freeze ends. {\"at_ms\":3500,\"client\":\"A\",\"op\":\"submit\",\"value\":\"zombie\",\"resource\":\"R\",\"force_submit\":true}\n49\t\t  ]\n50\t\t}`\n51\t\tres := runJSON(t, data)\n52\t\tassertAllInvariants(t, res)\n53\t\trep := res.Report\n54\t\n55\t\tif rep.Lock.Grants != 2 {\n56\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"want 2 grants, got %d\", rep.Lock.Grants)\n57\t\t}\n58\t\tif rep.Lock.Expirations != 1 {\"at_ms\":4000,\"client\":\"A\",\"op\":\"submit\",\"value\":\"a3\",\"resource\":\"R\"}\n92\t\t  ]\n93\t\t}`\n94\t\tres := runJSON(t, data)\n95\t\tassertAllInvariants(t, res)\n96\t\trep := Fencing tokens issued by the lock are strictly increasing.\n\tchecks = append(checks, checkFenceMonotonic(rep))\n\n\t// 2. Fences of committed writes never decrease. Lock grant/expire bookkeeping is consistent: grants are issued only\n\t//    when no live lease exists, and every expiration follows the TTL.\n\tchecks = append(checks, checkLeaseLifecycle(rep, trace))\n\n\t// 6. A stale fence write (fence below the resource epoch) observed in the\n\t//    trace is never followed by its commit.\n\tchecks = append(checks, checkNoStaleCommit(rep, trace))\n\n\treturn checks\n}\n\nfunc check(name string, pass bool, detail string) InvariantCheck {\n\treturn InvariantCheck{Name: name, Pass: pass, Detail: detail}\n}\n\nfunc checkFenceMonotonic(rep *Report) InvariantCheck {\n\tfor i, h := range rep.Lock.History {\n\t\tif h.Fence != int64(i+1) {\n\t\t\treturn check(\"fence_tokens_strictly_increasing\", false,\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"grant #%d has fence %d\", i+1, h.Fence))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn check(\"fence_tokens_strictly_increasing\", true,\n\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"%d tokens issued, fences 1..%d\", len(rep.Lock.History), rep.Lock.NextFence-1))\n}\n\nfunc checkCommittedFencesNondecreasing(rep *Report) InvariantCheck {\n\tvar prev int64\n\tfor i, c := range rep.Resource.Committed {\n\t\tif i > 0 && c.Fence < prev {\n\t\t\treturn check(\"committed_fences_never_decrease\", false,\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"commit #%d fence %d follows %d\", i+1, c.Fence, prev))\n\t\t}\n\t\tprev = c.Fence\n\t}\n\treturn rep.Resource.Rejected {\n\t\t// The recorded epoch is the max fence at the time of rejection.\n\t\tif rj.Reason == ResultStaleFence && rj.Fence >= rj.EpochFence {\n\t\t\treturn TraceEvent) bool { return e.Event == \"lock.grant\" })\n\texpires := trace.Select(func(e TraceEvent) bool { return e.Event == \"lock.expire\" })\n\n\t// A grant must never start while an earlier lease {"parentUuid":"b3685b44-bf02-4f90-b1f3-f6c78147ca4d","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/client.go","snippet":"1\tpackage sim\n2\t\n3\timport \"fmt\"\n4\t\n5\t// Client state.\n6\tconst (\n7\t\tStateIdle      = \"idle\"\n8\t\tStateHasLease  = \"has_lease\"\n9\t\tStateAcquiring = \"acquiring\"\n10\t\tStateLostLease = \"lost_lease\"\n11\t\tStateReleased  = \"released\"\n12\t)\n13\t\n14\t// ClientEventSummary is the client-side lifecycle counters used by reports.\n15\ttype ClientEventSummary struct {\n16\t\tID             string `json:\"id\"`\n17\t\tState          string `json:\"state\"`\n18\t\tLeaseID        string `json:\"lease_id\"`\n19\t\tFence          int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n20\t\tGranted        int64  `json:\"granted\"`\n21\t\tRenewed        int64  `json:\"renewed\"`\n22\t\tRenewFailures  int64  `json:\"renew_failures\"`\n23\t\tAcquireBusy    int64  `json:\"acquire_busy\"`\n24\t\tCommits        int64  `json:\"commits\"`\n25\t\tRejected       int64  `json:\"rejected\"`\n26\t\tDups           int64  `json:\"deduped\"`\n27\t\tPauses         int64  `json:\"pauses\"`\n28\t\tPausedFor      Time   `json:\"paused_ms_total\"`\n29\t\tHeartbeatsSent int64  `json:\"heartbeats_sent\"`\n30\t}\n31\t\n32\t// Client is a lock-using application node. It renews its lease by periodic\n33\t// heartbeat, survives message loss (via retries on acquire only) and can be\n34\t// paused by the scenario harness to model a long GC / scheduling stall.\n35\ttype Client struct {\n36\t\tid       string\n37\t\thb       Time\n38\t\tretryGap Time\n39\t\n40\t\tstate   string\n41\t\tleaseID string\n42\t\tfence   int64\n43\t\t// lastFence is the highest fence this client was ever granted. It is\n44\t\t// intentionally retained after lease loss: a zombie holder (paused\n45\t\t// process that never observed its expiry) still has its old token in\n46\t\t// memory and will keep presenting it. The resource must reject it.\n47\t\tlastFence int64\n48\t\texpire    Time\n49\t\n50\t\t// retryUntil is set by an acquire action with retry=true.\n51\t\tretry bool\n52\t\tseq   int64\n53\t\n54\t\ts ClientEventSummary\n55\t}\n56\t\n57\tfunc NewClient(id string, heartbeat, retryGap Time) *Client {\n58\t\tc := &Client{id: id, hb: heartbeat, retryGap: retryGap, state: StateIdle}\n59\t\tc.s.ID = id\n60\t\tc.s.State = StateIdle\n61\t\treturn c\n62\t}\n63\t\n64\tfunc (c *Client) ID() string { return c.id }\n65\t\n66\t// nextReqID returns a client-unique id embedded in every request; receivers\n67\t// use it to de-duplicate network duplicates and retransmissions.\n68\tfunc (c *Client) nextReqID(kind string) string {\n69\t\tc.seq++\n70\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%s:%d\", c.id, kind, c.seq)\n71\t}\n72\t\n73\tfunc (c *Client) send(h Host, e *Envelope) {\n74\t\th.Send(e)\n75\t}\n76\t\n77\tfunc (c *Client) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n78\t\tswitch msg.Type {\n79\t\tcase TypeAcquireAck:\n80\t\t\tc.onGranted(h, t, msg)\n81\t\tcase TypeAcquireBusy:\n82\t\t\tc.s.AcquireBusy++\n83\t\t\th.Log(\"client.acquire.busy\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"holder_expire\": msg.ExpireAt})\n84\t\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n85\t\t\t\th.SetTimer(c.id, TimerAcqRetry, t+c.retryGap)\n86\t\t\t} else {\n87\t\t\t\tc.state = StateIdle\n88\t\t\t}\n89\t\n90\t\tcase TypeRenewAck:\n91\t\t\t// Fixed-cadence heartbeats do not re-arm on ack (see onHeartbeat).\n92\t\t\tc.s.Renewed++\n93\t\t\tc.expire = msg.ExpireAt\n94\t\t\th.Log(\"client.renewed\", map[string]any{\"fence\": msg.Fence, \"expire_at\": msg.ExpireAt})\n95\t\n96\t\tcase TypeRenewErr:\n97\t\t\t// The lock service told us the lease is gone. A well-behaved client\n98\t\t\t// stops acting as the owner. The resource fence still exists for the\n99\t\t\t// case where this error never arrives.\n100\t\t\tc.s.RenewFailures++\n101\t\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n102\t\n103\t\tcase TypeReleaseAck:\n104\t\t\tc.state = StateReleased\n105\t\t\tc.fence = 0\n106\t\t\tc.leaseID = \"\"\n107\t\t\th.CancelTimer(c.id, TimerHeartbeat)\n108\t\t\th.Log(\"client.released\", map[string]any{})\n109\t\n110\t\tcase TypeReleaseErr:\n111\t\t\th.Log(\"client.release.err\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Reason})\n112\t\t\tc.loseLease(h, t, msg.Reason)\n113\t\n114\t\tcase TypeSubmitAck:\n115\t\t\tswitch msg.Result {\n116\t\t\tcase ResultCommitted:\n117\t\t\t\tc.s.Commits++\n118\t\t\tcase ResultDuplicate:\n119\t\t\t\tc.s.Dups++\n120\t\t\tdefault:\n121\t\t\t\tc.s.Rejected++\n122\t\t\t\th.Log(\"client.submit.rejected\", map[string]any{\"reason\": msg.Result, \"max_fence\": msg.Fence})\n123\t\t\t}\n124\t\t}\n125\t\tc.snapshotState()\n126\t}\n127\t\n128\tfunc (c *Client) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n129\t\tswitch name {\n130\t\tcase TimerHeartbeat:\n131\t\t\tc.onHeartbeat(h, t)\n132\t\tcase TimerAcqRetry:\n133\t\t\tif c.state == StateAcquiring && c.retry {\n134\t\t\t\tc.doAcquire(h, t)\n135\t\t\t}\n136\t\t}\n137\t}\n138\t\n139\t// onHeartbeat sends a renewal and re-arms the periodic timer. Heartbeats\n140\t// run on a fixed schedule measured from the grant, not from ack arrival:\n141\t// scheduling from the ack would let link latency drift the send times and\n142\t// model the wrong behavior. Multiple renews may briefly be in flight; the\n143\t// service rejects a renew once the lease moved on, which the client treats\n144\t// as lease loss.\n145\tfunc (c *Client) onHeartbeat(h Host, t {"parentUuid":"0776a65c-6f7f-4566-892a-6bda8608a62c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_akyqifgp4dtkoqgw5g558g3l","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/docs/REQUESTS.md","content":"# 请求样例（JSON 运行接口）\n\n本项目没有网络端口：**一次“请求”就是一个场景 JSON 文件**，由 `bin/sim -f <file>` 消费，\n输出一份运行报告 JSON。节点之间收发的报文也是 JSON 结构（`Envelope`），出现在报告的\n`trace` 中。本文给出三类可直接照抄的样例。\n\n- 完整场景见 [`scenarios/`](../scenarios)\n- 对应真实运行输出见 [`reports/`](../reports)（由本机构建实际跑出，非手写）\n\n---\n\n## 1. 最小场景：获取锁、提交、释放\n\n```json\n{\n  \"name\": \"minimal\",\n  \"seed\": 1,\n  \"ttl_ms\": 2000,\n  \"heartbeat_ms\": 600,\n  \"retry_gap_ms\": 200,\n  \"end_ms\": 3000,\n  \"network\": { \"min_latency_ms\": 10, \"max_latency_ms\": 10, \"rules\": [] },\n  \"clients\": [ { \"id\": \"A\" } ],\n  \"actions\": [\n    { \"at_ms\": 0,    \"client\": \"A\", \"op\": \"acquire\" },\n    { \"at_ms\": 200,  \"client\": \"A\", \"op\": \"submit\", \"value\": \"hello\", \"resource\": \"R\" },\n    { \"at_ms\": 1000, \"client\": \"A\", \"op\": \"release\" }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n字段含义：\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `ttl_ms` | 租约长度。未续约则在 `授予时刻 + ttl` 过期 |\n| `heartbeat_ms` | 客户端自动续约（心跳）周期，必须 **小于** `ttl_ms` |\n| `retry_gap_ms` | `acquire` 收到 `busy` 后重试的间隔 |\n| `end_ms` | 仿真终止时刻（逻辑毫秒） |\n| `seed` | 确定性随机种子；同种子 + 同输入 ⇒ 逐字节相同的报告 |\n| `network.rules` | 脚本化网络故障规则（见下） |\n\n`op` 取值：`acquire` / `renew` / `submit` / `release` / `pause` / `resume` / `note`。\n\n`acquire` 可加 `\"retry\": true`；`submit` 可加 `\"force_submit\": true`\n（模拟**僵尸旧持有者**：明知租约已失仍用旧围栏号提交，交由资源拒绝）。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 网络故障规则（丢包 / 重复 / 延迟乱序）\n\n规则在 `network.rules` 中按顺序匹配，首条命中生效；可用 `src`/`dst`/`req_type`/\n`msg_type`/时间窗 `from`–`until` 精确选择报文。\n\n```json\n\"network\": {\n  \"min_latency_ms\": 10,\n  \"max_latency_ms\": 10,\n  \"drop_prob\": 0.0,\n  \"duplicate_prob\": 0.0,\n  \"rules\": [\n    { \"type\": \"drop\",      \"src\": \"A\", \"dst\": \"L\", \"req_type\": \"renew\",\n      \"from\": 710, \"until\": 1430 },\n    { \"type\": \"duplicate\", \"src\": \"A\", \"dst\": \"R\", \"req_type\": \"submit\",\n      \"from\": 3440, \"until\": 3470 },\n    { \"type\": \"delay\",     \"src\": \"A\", \"dst\": \"L\", \"req_type\": \"renew\",\n      \"delay_ms\": 700 }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n- `drop`：报文永不送达。\n- `duplicate`：原件照送，额外再送一份（带 `duplicate_of` 指向原件 id）；\n  若指定 `delay_ms`，**原件也被延迟**该时长，副本紧随其后。\n- `delay`（`reorder` 同义）：把报文额外滞留 `delay_ms`，制造乱序/迟到。\n- 也可不写规则，直接给 `drop_prob` / `duplicate_prob` 做概率故障（由 `seed` 决定）。\n\n`req_type`：`acquire` / `renew` / `release` / `submit`。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 暂停节点（旧持有者继续运行的来源）\n\n```json\n{ \"at_ms\": 500, \"client\": \"A\", \"op\": \"pause\", \"duration_ms\": 2500 }\n```\n\n暂停期间：客户端定时器（心跳）与所有入站报文被冻结，暂停结束（可提前 `resume`）\n后在恢复时刻集中投递。若暂停跨越租约过期点，锁服务会把锁授予他人；恢复后的客户端\n仍持有**旧围栏号**，可这样强制提交：\n\n```json\n{ \"at_ms\": 3050, \"client\": \"A\", \"op\": \"submit\",\n  \"value\": \"zombie\", \"resource\": \"R\", \"force_submit\": true }\n```\n\n---\n\n## 报文样例（trace 中的真实 JSON）\n\n下面这些取自场景 2 的**实际运行**（逻辑毫秒）。\n\n授予锁（围栏号 1）：\n\n```json\n{\"time_ms\": 15, \"event\": \"lock.grant\",\n \"detail\": {\"client\": \"A\", \"fence\": 1, \"lease_id\": \"lease-1\", \"expire_at\": 1015}}\n```\n\nA 暂停过久，租约在 t=1438 过期，B 随后拿到**更大的**围栏号 2：\n\n```json\n{\"time_ms\": 1438, \"event\": \"lock.expire\",\n \"detail\": {\"holder\": \"A\", \"fence\": 1, \"lease_id\": \"lease-1\", \"expire_at\": 1438}}\n{\"time_ms\": 1477, \"event\": \"lock.grant\",\n \"detail\": {\"client\": \"B\", \"fence\": 2, \"lease_id\": \"lease-2\", \"expire_at\": 2477}}\n```\n\nB 的写入以围栏 2 提交：\n\n```json\n{\"time_ms\": 2212, \"event\": \"resource.commit\",\n \"detail\": {\"client\": \"B\", \"fence\": 2, \"req_id\": \"B:submit:6\", \"value\": \"b-write-fence-2\"}}\n```\n\nA 恢复后用旧围栏号 1 提交 —— 资源以 `stale_fence` 拒绝（`epoch_fence` 是资源已见的最大围栏）：\n\n```json\n{\"time_ms\": 3108, \"event\": \"resource.reject\",\n \"detail\": {\"client\": \"A\", \"fence\": 1, \"max_fence\": 2,\n            \"req_id\": \"A:submit:4\", \"reason\": \"stale_fence\"}}\n```\n\n重复的同一请求（相同 `req_id`）不会二次应用，返回 `duplicate`：\n\n```json\n{\"event\": \"lock.renew.dedup\", \"detail\": {\"client\": \"A\", \"req_id\": \"A:renew:3\", \"fence\": 1}}\n{\"event\": \"resource.submit.dedup\", \"detail\": {\"req_id\": \"A:submit:7\", \"fence\": 1}}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 运行\n\n```bash\ngo build -o bin/sim ./cmd/sim\nbin/sim -f scenarios/2-pause-longer-than-ttl.json            # 完整报告（含 trace）\nbin/sim -f scenarios/2-pause-longer-than-ttl.json -summary   # 不含逐条 trace\nbin/sim -f - < scenarios/1-renewal-lost.json                 # 从标准输入读\n```\n\n退出码：`0` 全部不变量通过；`1` 有不变量失败（协议/实现缺陷）；`2` 场景本身非法。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d07442478b9ccffa421f185d","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1191,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":108344,"output_tokens":2056,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_akyqifgp4dtkoqgw5g558g3l":{"content":"# (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"3b007121-ad76-43c6-baa5-70357152679c","timestamp":"2026-09-23T04:23:03.696Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a/internal/sim/resource.go","oldString":"func NewResource() *Resource {\n\treturn &Resource{seen: map[string]submitSeen{}}\n}","newString":"func NewResource() *Resource {\n\treturn &Resource{\n\t\tcommitted: []Commit{},\n\t\trejected:  []RejectedSubmit{},\n\t\tseen:      map[string]submitSeen{},\n\t}\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\n// Commit is one accepted write at the resource.\ntype Commit struct {\n\tAt     Time   `json:\"at\"`\n\tClient string `json:\"client\"`\n\tFence  int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tReqID  string `json:\"req_id\"`\n\tValue  string `json:\"value\"`\n}\n\n// RejectedSubmit records every refused write. The reject reason is the\n// observable proof that the fencing protocol stopped a stale holder.\ntype RejectedSubmit struct {\n\tAt         Time   `json:\"at\"`\n\tClient     string `json:\"client\"`\n\tFence      int64  `json:\"fence\"`\n\tReqID      string `json:\"req_id\"`\n\tReason     string `json:\"reason\"`\n\tEpochFence int64  `json:\"epoch_fence\"`\n}\n\n// ResourceSnapshot is the post-run state of the protected resource.\ntype ResourceSnapshot struct {\n\tNodeID      string           `json:\"node\"`\n\tCommitted   []Commit         `json:\"commits\"`\n\tRejected    []RejectedSubmit `json:\"rejected\"`\n\tMaxFence    int64            `json:\"max_fence\"`\n\tHolderFence int64            `json:\"holder_fence\"`\n}\n\n// Resource is a storage node that only applies writes tagged with the\n// highest fence it has ever seen. The lock service may grant a new lease\n// without the old holder knowing; this check is the second line of defense,\n// and is what makes a zombie holder harmless.\ntype Resource struct {\n\tcommitted []Commit\n\trejected  []RejectedSubmit\n\tmaxFence  int64\n\t// seen dedupes retransmitted / network-duplicated submit requests, so a\n\t// legitimate retry cannot double-apply.\n\tseen map[string]submitSeen\n}\n\ntype submitSeen struct {\n\tresult string\n\tfence  int64\n}\n\nfunc NewResource() *Resource {\n\treturn &Resource{seen: map[string]submitSeen{}}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Resource) ID() string { return ResourceID }\n\nfunc (r *Resource) HandleMessage(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tif msg.Type != TypeSubmitReq {\n\t\th.Log(\"resource.unexpected\", map[string]any{\"type\": msg.Type})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tack := &Envelope{Src: ResourceID, Dst: msg.Src, ReqType: ReqSubmit, ReqID: msg.ReqID}\n\n\t// Re-delivery of a request already accepted with the same fence:\n\t// idempotent success, not a second commit and not a stale write. Check\n\t// this before the fence comparison, since an even newer holder may have\n\t// committed in between the original and its duplicate.\n\tif prev, ok := r.seen[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\tack.Type = TypeSubmitAck\n\t\tack.Result = ResultDuplicate\n\t\tack.Fence = prev.fence\n\t\th.Log(\"resource.submit.dedup\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID, \"fence\": msg.Fence,\n\t\t})\n\t\th.Send(ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\treason := r.check(msg)\n\n\tif reason != \"\" {\n\t\tack.Type = TypeSubmitAck\n\t\tack.Result = reason\n\t\tack.Reason = reason\n\t\tack.Fence = r.maxFence\n\t\tr.rejected = append(r.rejected, RejectedSubmit{\n\t\t\tAt: t, Client: msg.Src, Fence: msg.Fence, ReqID: msg.ReqID,\n\t\t\tReason: reason, EpochFence: r.maxFence,\n\t\t})\n\t\th.Log(\"resource.reject\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"max_fence\": r.maxFence,\n\t\t\t\"req_id\": msg.ReqID, \"reason\": reason,\n\t\t})\n\t\th.Send(ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tc := Commit{At: t, Client: msg.Src, Fence: msg.Fence, ReqID: msg.ReqID, Value: msg.Value}\n\tr.committed = append(r.committed, c)\n\tr.maxFence = msg.Fence\n\tr.seen[msg.ReqID] = submitSeen{result: ResultCommitted, fence: msg.Fence}\n\tack.Type = TypeSubmitAck\n\tack.Result = ResultCommitted\n\tack.Fence = msg.Fence\n\tack.Value = msg.Value\n\th.Log(\"resource.commit\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"fence\": msg.Fence, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID, \"value\": msg.Value,\n\t})\n\th.Send(ack)\n}\n\n// check returns \"\" when the write may be applied, otherwise the reject\n// result code. Rule: a fence greater than every fence seen so far commits;\n// anything smaller is a stale holder; zero means the caller never held the\n// lock at all.\nfunc (r *Resource) check(msg *Envelope) string {\n\tswitch {\n\tcase msg.Fence <= 0:\n\t\treturn ResultFenceZero\n\tcase msg.Fence < r.maxFence:\n\t\treturn ResultStaleFence\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Resource) OnTimer(Host, Time, string)       {}\nfunc (r *Resource) OnAction(Host, Time, *ActionSpec) {}\nfunc (r *Resource) OnPause(Host, Time)               {}\nfunc (r *Resource) OnResume(Host, Time)              {}\n\n// Snapshot returns the terminal resource state.\nfunc (r *Resource) Snapshot() ResourceSnapshot {\n\tsnap := ResourceSnapshot{\n\t\tNodeID:      ResourceID,\n\t\tCommitted:   append([]Commit(nil), r.committed...),\n\t\tRejected:    append([]RejectedSubmit(nil), r.rejected...),\n\t\tMaxFence:    r.maxFence,\n\t\tHolderFence: r.maxFence,\n\t}\n\treturn snap\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":48,"oldLines":7,"newStart":48,"newLines":11,"lines":[" }"," "," func NewResource() *Resource {","-  return &Resource{seen: map[string]submitSeen{}}","+  return &Resource{","+    committed: []Commit{},","+    rejected:  []RejectedSubmit{},","+    seen:      map[string]submitSeen{},","+  }"," }"," "," func (r *Resource) ID() string { return ResourceID }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6ff8b4b9-4873-4210-b940-6393f30dfd6b","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}

msg.Type})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnTimer(h Host, t Time, name string) {\n\tif name != TimerLockExpire {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tl.expireIfDue(h, t)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) OnAction(Host, Time, *ActionSpec) {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnPause(Host, Time)               {}\nfunc (l *LockService) OnResume(Host, Time)              {}\n\n// expireIfDue lazily expires the current lease, and Expiry is what lets the lock move to a new holder\n// while the old one may still believe it holds the lock.\nfunc (l *LockService) expireIfDue(h Host, t Time) {\n\tif l.current == nil || t < l.current.ExpireAt {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdead := l.current\n\tl.current = nil\n\tl.expires++\n\th.CancelTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire)\n\th.Log(\"lock.expire\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"holder\": dead.Holder, \"lease_id\": dead.ID, \"fence\": dead.Fence,\n\t\t\"expire_at\": dead.ExpireAt, \"at\": t,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) reply(h Host, t Time, req *Envelope, ack *Envelope) {\n\tack.Src = LockID\n\tack.Dst = req.Src\n\tack.ReqType = req.ReqType\n\tack.ReqID = req.ReqID\n\tack.SendTime = t\n\th.Send(ack)\n}\n\nfunc (l *LockService) handleAcquire(h Host, t Time, msg *Envelope) {\n\tif cached, ok := l.acquireCache[msg.ReqID]; ok {\n\t\th.Log(\"lock.release.replay\", map[string]any{\"client\": msg.Src, \"req_id\": msg.ReqID})\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, cached)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif l.current == nil || l.current.Holder != msg.Src || l.current.ID != msg.LeaseID {\n\t\tl.reply(h, t, msg, &Envelope{\n\t\t\tType: TypeReleaseErr, Result: ResultExpired, Reason: \"not the live lease\",\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\treleased := l.current\n\tl.current = nil\n\th.CancelTimer(LockID, TimerLockExpire)\n\tack := &Envelope{Type: TypeReleaseAck, Result: ResultCommitted, Fence: released.Fence}\n\tl.releaseCache[msg.ReqID] = ack\n\th.Log(\"lock.release\", map[string]any{\n\t\t\"client\": msg.Src, \"lease_id\": released.ID, \"fence\": released.Fence,\n\t})\n\tl.reply(h, t, msg, ack)\n}\n\n// Snapshot returns the terminal state for the run report.\nfunc (l *LockService) Snapshot() LockSnapshot {\n\tsnap := LockSnapshot{\n\t\tNodeID:      LockID,\n\t\tNextFence:   l.nextFence,\n\t\tGrants:      l.grants,\n\t\tExpirations: int64(l.expires),\n\t\tHistory:     append([]Lease(nil), l.history...),\n\t}\n\tif l.current != nil {\n\t\tc := *l.current\n\t\tsnap.Current = &c\n\t}\n\treturn snap\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":66,"oldLines":6,"newStart":66,"newLines":7,"lines":["   return &LockService{","     ttl:          ttl,","     nextFence:    1,","+    history:      []Lease{},","     renewCache:   map[string]renewResult{},","     acquireCache: map[string]*Envelope{},","     releaseCache: map[string]*Envelope{},"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"staleRecovered":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"336d32f9-ff85-4d7c-8014-3e54d85c1e79","session_id":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp22/a","sessionId":"5ba36793-6e62-4edd-8099-8452466ff87b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp22-a","slug":"soft-painting-storm"}
